Previews show the potential stage gain only when predicted HP damage can occur.

Name: Keen Eye
Description: The Pokémon's keen eyes prevent its accuracy from being lowered.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described accuracy or evasion change in attack hit-chance resolution under its stated condition.
Exact Description: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering this Pokémon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokémon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION FOR REVIEW: because accuracy/evasion stages do not exist, the holder's damaging moves ignore ability-generated evasion factors such as Sand Veil and Snow Cloak. They still respect their own authored accuracy, Hustle, range, cover, line of sight, protection, and type/ability immunities. Once accuracy stages are explicitly added, Keen Eye must also reject other-unit accuracy drops and ignore the target's evasion stage; do not simulate those as Attack or Speed changes. This self-only continuous effect has no AP cost, duration, chance, or extra action. Use a shared hit-context override in combat, preview, and AI; previews report adjusted probabilities without drawing RNG or bypassing ordinary move legality.

Name: Klutz
Description: The Pokémon can't use any held items.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Disable the holder passive and triggered held-item effects while it is deployed.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's held item has no effect. This Pokémon cannot use Fling successfully. Macho Brace, Power Anklet, Power Band, Power Belt, Power Bracer, Power Lens, and Power Weight still have their effects.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While active, ignore the holder's equipment-derived offensive/defensive multipliers, periodic healing, automatic consumable effects, and battle Special item actions, including Mega activation. The held item remains equipped and can still be inspected, stolen, or removed through separately authored rules; Klutz does not consume or delete it. Bag-level Ability Capsule/Patch usage between battles is unaffected. Remove the restriction while suppressed, restoring item effects without retriggering consumed items. DEPENDENCY: centralize item-effect availability so engine, damage, scheduler, menus, and AI share the rule; future Fling must fail while Klutz is active. Source-listed training-item exceptions remain gated on those actual item definitions rather than creating inert exceptions now. No AP or stage changes occur.

Name: Leaf Guard
Description: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Check the described immunity or prevention rule before applying the affected status, move, stat, or field effect.
Exact Description: If Sun is active, this Pokémon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn, and Rest will fail for it. This effect is prevented if this Pokémon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: During effective sun, reject new major statuses against the holder, including Burn and paralysis now and future poison, sleep, freeze, or delayed-sleep marks only after their typed rules exist. Existing statuses continue until their own cure or expiry; Leaf Guard does not heal or cleanse them. Self-inflicted major statuses are also blocked, so future Rest requires an explicit failure path. The protection is continuous and self-only with no chance, AP cost, stack, or separate duration. Weather suppression or ability suppression removes it immediately while the weather timer continues. Utility Umbrella exceptions depend on a real held-item rule. Apply the guard before seeded status chances where possible, and report prevention consistently in previews and logs.

Name: Levitate
Description: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Mark the unit airborne and make Ground-type attacks fail its matchup check.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokémon as if it did not have this Ability.
Game Implementation: Mark the unit airborne and make Ground-type attacks fail its matchup check.

Name: Libero
Description: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described type change in move or hit resolution and update the holder battle types for its stated duration.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokémon is not Terastallized. Gen 8: type changes before every eligible move, without the once-per-entry restriction.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Once per battle, immediately before the holder executes its first legal equipped move, replace its current battle types with that move's final resolved type. This includes Status moves and happens after all move-type conversions, before STAB, immunity, and damage. Spend the trigger even if the move later misses; rejected commands do not spend it. Keep the new pure type until battle end or a later explicit type-changing effect; change no intrinsic stats, mobility permissions, AP cost, or move slots. DEPENDENCY: add saved battle-type override provenance and a spent flag, plus Terastallization exclusion only when that system exists. This deployment-based restriction replaces once-per-switch-in; ability reacquisition does not reset it.

Name: Light Metal
Description: Halves the Pokémon's weight.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Store the weight modifier on the unit and read it in weight-sensitive move effects.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's weight is halved (0.5x), rounded down to a tenth of a kilogram. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone. A Pokémon's weight will not drop below 0.1 kg.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: add authored species mass, a shared effective-mass resolver, and weight-dependent moves before registering Light Metal. While active, halve this holder's effective mass, rounded down to 0.1 kg and never below 0.1 kg, after any authored Autotomize reduction and before Float Stone. This continuous multiplier can alter incoming or outgoing weight-based move power but does not grant Speed, Movement, flying mobility, AP, evasion, or damage reduction by itself. Suppression immediately restores ordinary effective mass without mutating the species catalog or intrinsic rank stats. Apply once rather than repeatedly on turn boundaries, and expose the same weight and power consequences in inspection, previews, AI, and save restoration.

Name: Lightning Rod
Description: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. If this Pokémon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokémon, this Pokémon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokémon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Before a single-target Electric move resolves, search living unsuppressed Lightning Rod holders within the attacker's legal resolved move range and line of sight, excluding its original caster. Redirect to the eligible holder with highest effective Speed, then stable battle-unit order; either side may qualify. Area moves are not redirected but can still be absorbed per recipient. After its successful hit check, the holder prevents Electric damage and attached on-hit effects and gains +1 Special Attack for five cycles, capped at +6 with expiry refresh. Apply once per incoming move recipient, never healing or granting AP. DEPENDENCY: add redirection before target reflection/absorption, shared resolved-target previews, and source-aware immunity checks so AI predicts the same destination.

Name: Limber
Description: The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Reject paralysis when a status effect is applied to this unit.
Exact Description: This Pokémon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.
Game Implementation: Reject paralysis when that status effect is applied to this unit.

Name: Lingering Aroma
Description: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: Pokémon making contact with this Pokémon have their Ability changed to Lingering Aroma. Does not affect Pokémon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Lingering Aroma, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: add battle-only ability-slot replacement, suppression/uncopyable metadata, and save-safe restoration. After a successful contact damaging hit, use the defender's hit snapshot to replace the living attacker's given ability with Lingering Aroma at 100% probability, even if the holder fainted; retain its hidden slot. If the given ability is an authored unreplaceable species/form ability from the Exact Description exclusions, or already Lingering Aroma, do nothing and never overwrite the hidden slot instead. Long Reach, misses, immunity, and damage-only chains prevent the trigger. Replacement lasts until battle end and can spread through later contact. Do not fire deployment triggers or change owned choices; log the overwritten slot and reschedule changed Speed proportionally.

Name: Liquid Ooze
Description: The strong stench of the Pokémon's oozed liquid damages attackers that use HP-draining moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: implement authored HP-drain move effects with a distinct amount-to-heal event before enabling Liquid Ooze. Whenever another unit would restore HP by draining this holder, prevent that heal and instead deal that exact would-be restored amount to the drainer as indirect ability damage. Determine the amount after the move's drain fraction and ordinary drain modifiers but before capping to the drainer's missing HP, so a full-HP drainer can still be harmed. This applies once per actual drain recipient event, at any range, without contact or chance. It does not reverse ordinary healing, potions, absorption, or non-draining damage. Magic Guard can prevent the indirect loss; retaliation cannot recursively drain or trigger contact reactions.

Name: Liquid Voice
Description: Sound-based moves become Water-type moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described type change in move or hit resolution and update the holder battle types for its stated duration.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's sound-based moves become Water-type moves. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Build the move's pre-ability profile from authored move/weather/item changes, then inspect active given before hidden slots. Liquid Voice qualifies for sound-tagged moves; if it is the first eligible ability converter, set the type to Water with no power bonus. A preceding eligible converter wins, and later converters cannot replace it or stack a bonus. Status moves keep their authored effects while changing type. Use explicit sound metadata rather than names or audio assets. Preserve AP cost, range, shape, category, delivery, and contact tags. DEPENDENCY: implement ordered resolved-move conversion, separately authored future final overrides, and shared final-type queries for STAB, weather, absorption, legality, previews, and AI without catalog mutation.

Name: Long Reach
Description: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's attacks do not make contact with the target.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Remove the effective contact property from every move used by this holder before checking defensive contact reactions, item triggers, or contact-based ability conditions. The move keeps its original category, range, melee/ranged delivery, power, animation, and AP cost; Long Reach does not increase tile reach or bypass line of sight. Static, Flame Body, Rough Skin, Iron Barbs, Gooey, Mummy, and similar contact effects therefore do not trigger from the holder's attacks. Tough Claws also loses its eligibility because the resolved move no longer makes contact. This is a continuous, deterministic override with no duration or charge. Centralize effective tags for damage, reactions, previews, and enemy scoring rather than mutating catalog tags.

Name: Magic Bounce
Description: The Pokémon reflects status moves instead of getting hit by them.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add an incoming-hit hook; check the described move or damage condition, then apply its prevention, healing, or stat response.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or Magic Coat's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokémon under this or Magic Coat's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this Ability takes effect.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: mark reflectable targeted Status effects, add a reflected-event flag, and make reflection share legality/effect guards. When a reflectable hostile Status move targets this holder, prevent its effects here and send one equivalent effect event back to the original caster at no AP cost; bypass distance for that return only. Reflected events cannot reflect again, spend an Attack command, or trigger Dancer-style copies. Area moves reflect only the holder's recipient effect while other recipients resolve normally. For authored side hazards, choose the earliest living Magic Bounce holder in stable defending-unit order and reflect the placement once per side. Resolve Lightning Rod-style redirection first; damaging moves and ordinary weather/Trick Room casts remain unaffected.

Name: Magic Guard
Description: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon can only be damaged by direct attacks. Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, Struggle recoil, and confusion damage are considered direct damage.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Reject indirect HP damage to this holder, including Burn/poison ticks, sandstorm, lava, entry hazards, ordinary recoil, and ability retaliation, through one shared origin-aware guard. Direct damaging attacks, Struggle recoil, confusion self-hits, explicit HP payments such as Substitute/Belly Drum/Curse on use, and direct HP-setting such as Pain Split remain allowed; future exceptions need typed provenance rather than name guessing. Status application, negative stages, displacement, locks, and healing are unaffected, so Burn still reduces Physical damage despite its blocked tick. Protection is continuous, self-only, deterministic, and unlimited while unsuppressed. DEPENDENCY: classify every HP-loss/payment/set path before registration and route existing helpers through the guard, with matching previews, AI, logs, and KO settlement.

Name: Magician
Description: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a held-item trigger that checks the described condition and applies the stated item interaction.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokémon it hits with an attack. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight. If multiple targets are hit by an attack the item is stolen from the fastest Pokémon, while considering the effect of Trick Room and prioritizing opposing Pokémon before allies.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: After the holder's damaging move successfully removes HP, if the holder is empty-handed, steal one eligible recipient's held item. For an area attack, prefer opposing recipients, then earliest next scheduled action under the current AV/Trick Room state, then stable battle-unit order. Resolve once after the complete move event, not per recipient; misses, immunity, empty slots, and future delayed attacks do not qualify. DEPENDENCY: implement transferable-item metadata, battle-only ownership provenance, item-effect recalculation, and a settlement policy. Proposed policy returns stolen equipment to its original owner after battle, preventing player/enemy inventory duplication, and needs designer review. Unremovable form items and compatible Mega Stones are ineligible. Gain no AP or extra Attack action.

Name: Magma Armor
Description: The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Check the described immunity or prevention rule before applying the affected status, move, stat, or field effect.
Exact Description: This Pokémon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Continuously prevent the holder from receiving freeze, and cure existing freeze immediately when this ability becomes active. DEPENDENCY: add an authored freeze status with duration, thaw rules, action restrictions, seeded application, save validation, and shared status hooks; snow itself currently supplies no freeze state. Check immunity before applying a move's freeze chance and report prevention without consuming an unnecessary RNG roll. This does not prevent Ice attack damage, snow's defensive bonus, paralysis, Burn, sleep, poison, or movement through ice-themed tiles. There is no AP cost, probability, limited trigger count, or stage change. Suppression removes the guard; reactivation can cure again through a single idempotent activation event.

Name: Magnet Pull
Description: Prevents Steel-type Pokémon from fleeing by pulling them in with magnetism.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Check the described immunity or prevention rule before applying the affected status, move, stat, or field effect.
Exact Description: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokémon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell or are a Ghost type.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION FOR REVIEW: use the existing trapping-aura model rather than an absent switching command. While the living holder is active, an opposing Steel-type unit entering its 5-Manhattan-tile radius becomes magnet-bound and can choose Move destinations only inside that radius. It still pays 1 AP, gets one Move command, and follows normal path/occupancy rules. Ghost-type recipients are exempt; Shed Shell exemption is gated on that actual item rule. Track source/recipient entry and exit, recompute after displacement, and release the bind immediately if the source faints, is suppressed, or the target ceases to be eligible. Multiple binders intersect legal destination regions without stacking numerical penalties; always allow Pass and attacks.

Name: Marvel Scale
Description: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost its Defense stat if it has a status condition.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, raise the holder Defense through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5 (+50%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While the holder has at least one active major status, multiply its effective Defense by 1.5 before Physical damage calculation. Active Burn and paralysis qualify using battle-time expiry; future poison, sleep, and freeze require their typed rules first. Confusion, move locks, negative stages, and weather conditions do not qualify. This is one continuous multiplier rather than a Defense stage, so several simultaneous statuses never stack it or refresh stage timers. Status penalties, periodic damage, and normal cure/expiry remain intact. The bonus vanishes immediately on cure or suppression and affects neither Special damage nor indirect HP loss. Use the same condition and effective Defense in pure previews, inspection, AI, and resolution.

Name: Mega Launcher
Description: Powers up pulse moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's pulse moves have their power multiplied by 1.5 (+50%). Heal Pulse restores 3/4 (75%) of a target's maximum HP, rounded half down.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Multiply the base power of the holder's damaging pulse-tagged moves by 1.5. Qualification depends on authored pulse metadata rather than move names, projectile delivery, or sound tags; apply once per resolved move profile to all area recipients. No AP discount, extra Attack action, stage, or duration is granted. DEPENDENCY: a future Heal Pulse must have an explicit targeted-healing effect and compatibility entry; Mega Launcher changes that move's authored heal to 75% maximum HP, using the game's ceil/minimum-1 rounding and maximum-HP cap, without amplifying unrelated healing. Keep damage and healing branches separate, with shared tags, previews, AI scoring, suppression handling, and feedback. Existing pulse-tagged damage can use the ordinary modifier family.

Name: Mega Sol
Description: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Let this unit moves use harsh-sunlight damage rules without changing displayed battle weather.
Exact Description: This Pokémon uses its moves as if harsh sunlight were active without changing the actual weather. For its moves, Fire damage is multiplied by 1.5 (+50%) and Water damage by 0.5 (-50%); Solar Beam and Solar Blade skip their charging turn; Weather Ball becomes Fire type with 100 base power. Other Pokémon continue to use the actual weather.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Resolve this holder's moves against private effective sun without changing battlefield weather. Its outgoing Fire damage uses x1.5 and Water x0.5 instead of stacking actual weather modifiers; everyone else and the holder's defensive/residual interactions retain real weather. DEPENDENCY: add a move-scoped weather resolver. Future Solar Beam/Solar Blade skip charging and Weather Ball uses its authored Fire/100-power sun profile only after those moves exist. Proposed suppression contract: Air Lock/Cloud Nine suspend private-sun move modifiers, and Neutralizing Gas suppresses Mega Sol itself; this explicit choice needs designer review. Do not activate global Chlorophyll, Leaf Guard, or allies' sun effects. The continuous bonus grants no AP or action and shares one resolved context across combat, previews, and AI.

Name: Merciless
Description: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described critical-hit adjustment when calculating the holder attack chance.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: If the target has an active poison or badly-poisoned status at hit resolution, force the holder's damaging attack against that recipient to be a critical hit instead of making the normal 1-in-24 critical roll. A miss, immunity, Status move, or unpoisoned recipient retains ordinary handling. Apply independently to each area target, honoring critical-hit immunity such as Battle Armor/Shell Armor before forcing the result. DEPENDENCY: implement poison status identity, expiry/persistence policy, and cure rules first; an arbitrary status-record key cannot qualify. The ability never poisons, changes AP, or adds attacks. Share the forced-critical branch and critical-stage bypasses in pure previews and enemy scoring; display certainty without consuming preview RNG.

Name: Mimicry
Description: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described type change in move or hit resolution and update the holder battle types for its stated duration.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's types change to match the active Terrain when this Pokémon acquires this Ability, or whenever a Terrain begins. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. If this Ability is acquired without an active Terrain, or a Terrain ends, this Pokémon's types become the original types for its species.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: add a saved battlefield-terrain enum/expiry and a reversible type-override source. While an effective terrain exists, replace this holder's battle types with pure Electric for Electric Terrain, Grass for Grassy, Fairy for Misty, or Psychic for Psychic, regardless of grounded state. Reevaluate on ability activation, terrain creation/replacement/expiry, or suppression, restoring its authored species types when no terrain is active. This is not triggered by physical grass, water, mud, cover, hazards, or weather. Change no HP, stats, movement permissions, AP, or move slots, and do not accumulate types. Previews, STAB, immunity, and AI use the resulting current types; temporary overrides clear at battle end.

Name: Mind’s Eye
Description: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described accuracy or evasion change in attack hit-chance resolution under its stated condition.
Exact Description: This Pokémon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. Prevents other Pokémon from lowering this Pokémon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokémon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When this holder attacks, remove only the Ghost-type immunity component against its resolved Normal- or Fighting-type damaging moves, then calculate the target's other type modifiers normally. A Ghost/Rock target still retains Rock's applicable resistance. ADAPTATION FOR REVIEW: also ignore ability-derived evasion factors because accuracy/evasion stages currently do not exist, while preserving authored accuracy, Hustle, range, protection, and ability immunity. Future accuracy stages require the reference's accuracy-drop prevention and target-evasion bypass through explicit hooks. This continuous self-only ability supplies no stages, AP, or extra attacks. DEPENDENCY: expose per-defending-type effectiveness components so the override does not incorrectly neutralize all target immunities or resistances.

Name: Minus
Description: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, raise the holder named stat through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokémon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5 (+50%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While at least one other living allied unit has an active unsuppressed Plus or Minus ability, multiply this holder's effective Special Attack by 1.5. Scope is the whole battlefield, matching the source and existing support precedents; the holder cannot satisfy its own condition through another slot. Additional qualifying allies do not multiply the bonus further, and duplicate ability IDs apply once. Suppression, fainting, or removal of the last qualifying ally immediately ends the modifier. This is continuous, not a stage or deployment proc, so it does not refresh stat timers or grant AP. Evaluate the shared active-ability profile for both given and unlocked hidden slots in damage, previews, inspection, and AI.

Name: Mirror Armor
Description: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described named stat modifier in battle stat calculation while its condition is active.
Exact Description: When one of this Pokémon's stat stages would be lowered by another Pokémon, that Pokémon's stat stage is lowered instead. This effect does not happen if this Pokémon's stat stage was already -6. If the other Pokémon has a substitute, neither Pokémon has its stat stage lowered.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When another unit would lower one of this holder's five supported stat stages, prevent that recipient drop and apply the same negative delta to the original source instead. Do nothing if the holder was already at -6 in that stat; ordinary immunity can still block the reflected drop. Add a reflection flag so Mirror Armor cannot bounce indefinitely, and preserve the normal five-cycle expiry with +/-6 caps on the actual recipient. Self-inflicted changes, stage expiry, global Curious Medicine resets, and continuous stat multipliers are not reflected. DEPENDENCY: source-aware stage events, substitute guards, and shared interception order must exist. No chance, AP cost, or limited trigger count applies; log both the prevented and reflected effects.

Name: Misty Surge
Description: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
Proposed: PROPOSED: On deployment, set Misty Terrain in a new battle-terrain state and apply its field effects.
Exact Description: On entry, starts Misty Terrain for 5 turns, or 8 turns if this Pokémon holds a Terrain Extender. Grounded Pokémon cannot receive major status conditions or become confused, and Dragon-type moves deal half damage (0.5x) to grounded targets.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: implement saved battlefield terrain, a shared grounded predicate, and status-application guards. At deployment, create Misty Terrain for five cycles, replacing earlier terrain. Grounded units on both teams cannot receive major statuses or confusion, and resolved Dragon attack damage against grounded recipients is multiplied by 0.5. Existing statuses remain; airborne units receive neither protection nor reduction. There is no Fairy power bonus. Terrain Extender's eight-cycle variant requires an authored held-item rule. Terrain expiry/replacement removes the effects immediately, while weather and physical map tiles remain independent. Simultaneous setters resolve in stable battle-unit order. Previews show recipient-specific protection and damage without consuming RNG; future sleep/poison/freeze/confusion need their own complete status rules.

Name: Mold Breaker
Description: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Skip the target ability checks for this unit move resolution.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokémon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokémon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokémon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokémon.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: add a move-scoped defensive-ability bypass context with a reviewed suppressible allowlist based on the Exact Description, covering recipients and relevant field sources. During this holder's declared move only, ignore eligible immunity, absorption, evasion, defense, status/stage protection, and ally-aura effects for that move's resolution; restore them immediately afterward. Do not globally disable abilities, erase charged states, trigger entry bonuses, bypass equipment, or suppress protected form abilities/Full Metal Body. Contact and post-hit reactions follow their own explicit bypass metadata rather than blanket deletion. Applies to damaging and Status moves, all affected recipients, without AP surcharge or extra actions. Engine, pure previews, targeting, and AI must use the identical scoped profile.

Name: Moody
Description: Every turn, one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted sharply but another stat will be lowered.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Run the described passive effect at each battle cycle tick while the holder is active.
Exact Description: This Pokémon has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn. Gen 7 and earlier: accuracy and evasion were also eligible random stats.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: At the end of each completed holder turn, including Pass, choose one of Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed uniformly with seeded combat RNG and apply +2 stages; then choose uniformly from the other four stats and apply -1. Each affected stat uses the ordinary +/-6 cap and a refreshed five-cycle expiry, including attempts at cap. Accuracy and evasion are never eligible. Apply shared stage interception such as Contrary separately to the two events, then reschedule Speed changes once after both resolve. This occurs once per actual holder turn, not per action or global cycle, and gives no AP. Save RNG and stage expiries so reload cannot reroll the outcome; preview the distribution only.

Name: Motor Drive
Description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add an incoming-hit hook; check the described move or damage condition, then apply its prevention, healing, or stat response.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: After an incoming resolved Electric move passes hit/protection checks, absorb its damage and attached on-hit effects, then grant the holder +1 Speed for five cycles. Absorption precedes ordinary type effectiveness, so a Ground-type holder also gains the reward; a miss, protection, or scoped ability bypass prevents it. Repeated hits add stages to +6 and refresh expiry. Resolve once per incoming move recipient, with given-slot then hidden-slot ordering so overlapping absorbers never reward one hit twice. Rescale waiting AV immediately; AP gain remains 3 and Move/Attack limits stay unchanged. DEPENDENCY: extend absorption to source-aware stage rewards and share ordered guards with pure damage, targeting, previews, AI, and suppression. Indirect Electric-themed hazards do not trigger it.

Name: Moxie
Description: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, raise the holder Attack through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokémon.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When this holder's direct attack damage KOs an opposing unit, raise the surviving holder's Attack by 1 stage for five cycles. Each distinct opponent defeated by an area move may trigger once, processed in stable battle-unit order; a damage-only chain attributable to this attack also counts as its KO. Burn, weather, tile hazards, self-damage, ability retaliation, and allied KOs do not qualify. Repeated eligible KOs add up to +6 and refresh only Attack's expiry, using shared stage guards and Contrary. The ability never grants AP or another Attack command and cannot activate after the holder has fainted. Preview potential KO bonuses without committing stages or consuming RNG, and settle reactions before battle victory.

Name: Multiscale
Description: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved (0.5x).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: If this holder is at exactly maximum HP immediately before a successful direct damaging hit, multiply that hit's final damage by 0.5 using the shared rounding order. Any earlier HP loss removes eligibility; healing fully restores it for later moves. For area damage, evaluate the holder independently of other recipients; future sequential multi-hit moves recheck HP before each hit rather than shielding the whole sequence. Burn, sandstorm, lava, recoil, hazards, and ability damage are unchanged. This continuous condition has no charge, five-cycle timer, AP cost, or chance and is disabled by eligible ability suppression. Add it to the common damage pipeline so previews, AI, and actual first-hit HP loss agree.

Name: Multitype
Description: Changes the Pokémon's type to match the plate it holds.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described type change in move or hit resolution and update the holder battle types for its stated duration.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is an Arceus, its type changes to match its held Plate.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: register Arceus, typed Plate-to-element mappings, plate compatibility, and a reversible battle-type override before publishing this ability. While an eligible Arceus holder equips an authored Plate, replace its battle types with that Plate's single type; no Plate restores its species default. Reevaluate on battle creation and legal item changes without triggering entry abilities or altering HP, stats, Movement, AP, or move slots. Unrelated items and non-Arceus Capsule recipients cannot activate the rule. Mark Multitype and its required Plates unreplaceable/unremovable according to shared form metadata, rather than relying on ability names. Previews, STAB, immunity, inspection, and save validation must reflect the resulting types; this proposal adds no unregistered Judgment behavior.

Name: Mummy
Description: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Mummy.
Proposed: PROPOSED: On contact, replace the attacker ability with Mummy in the post-hit reaction hook.
Exact Description: Pokémon making contact with this Pokémon have their Ability changed to Mummy. Does not affect Pokémon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Mummy, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: add saved battle-only ability replacements and unreplaceable-species/form metadata from the Exact Description exclusions. After a successful contact damaging hit, use the defender's hit snapshot to replace the living attacker's given ability with Mummy at 100% probability, even if this holder fainted; keep the hidden slot intact. If that given ability is already Mummy or unreplaceable, no transfer occurs and the hidden slot is not an alternative. Misses, immunity, Long Reach, and damage-only chains never trigger it. Mummy can spread later, with no AP or replayed deployment bonuses. Suppression disables effects without restoring the slot; battle settlement restores owned choices. Update effective stats and proportionally reschedule changed Speed after replacement.

Name: Mycelium Might
Description: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, modify the holder named stat through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's Status moves ignore certain Abilities of other Pokémon, and go last among Pokémon using the same or greater priority moves.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When this holder executes a Status-category move, resolve that move through the same reviewed defensive-ability bypass allowlist as Mold Breaker, affecting only relevant recipients and field defenses during that cast. Damaging moves never receive the bypass. ADAPTATION FOR REVIEW: because the scheduler has no move-priority brackets, after the paid Status action add 2,500 AV to this holder's next scheduled action; queue this shift once for the complete command and apply it when its turn ends. Do not delay teammates, interrupt another actor, reset action flags, or change 3 AP gain/banking. DEPENDENCY: shared scoped bypass and next-action previews are required; underlying Status move effects must already be fully implemented.

Name: Natural Cure
Description: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, modify the holder named stat through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: This Pokémon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION FOR REVIEW: replace the absent switch-out cure with deliberate rest. At the end of the holder's own turn, if it used neither Move nor Attack, cure one active major status in the fixed order sleep, freeze, poison, Burn, paralysis. A Special action is allowed during rest, and only implemented status types participate until their own rules exist. Resolve once per completed holder turn, including Pass; do not cure at every action or global cycle. Negative stages, confusion, move locks, and HP loss remain unchanged. Status-inflicted skipped activations count as completed resting turns only after that status's turn rules are authored. Clearing paralysis reschedules future AV; no healing or AP bonus is granted.

Name: Neuroforce
Description: Powers up moves that are super effective.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's attacks that are super effective against the target have their damage multiplied by 1.25 (+25%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When this holder's resolved damaging move has a type-effectiveness multiplier greater than 1 against its recipient, multiply final damage by 1.25 using the shared fixed-point modifier order. A 2x matchup therefore gains this additional 25% bonus; neutral, resisted, immune, Status, and indirect damage receive none. Evaluate separately for each area recipient after type conversion and immunity overrides, not from displayed move color or the target's original species type. The effect is continuous and has no duration, stage, chance, AP surcharge, or trigger charge. Duplicate IDs do not stack, while distinct eligible offensive modifiers combine normally. Share the same recipient-specific rule with pure damage previews, board matchup cues, suppression, and enemy scoring.

Name: Neutralizing Gas
Description: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.
Proposed: PROPOSED: While deployed, disable other units ability hooks; resume them when this unit leaves battle.
Exact Description: While this Pokémon is active, Abilities have no effect. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect. Does not affect the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: add a derived active-ability overlay with protected species/form exceptions matching the Exact Description, and source-aware ordering before deployment hazards and entry abilities. While any living unsuppressed Neutralizing Gas source exists, suppress both given and active hidden ability effects of all other units except metadata-marked exceptions; Gas sources do not suppress one another. Recompute immediately after source KO, ability replacement, or suppression changes. Preserve underlying chosen slots, charged flags, once-per-battle flags, and weather timers, but remove derived buffs, immunity, and aura effects while suppressed. Ending Gas restores continuous effects without replaying deployment triggers. Reschedule Speed changes proportionally. No AP or action is spent; previews and AI must derive the same overlay without mutation.

Name: No Guard
Description: The Pokémon employs no-guard tactics to ensure incoming and outgoing attacks always land.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Attack modifier in battle stat calculation while its condition is active.
Exact Description: Every move used by or against this Pokémon will always hit.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Any move used by or against this holder skips the ordinary hit/miss roll and is treated as hitting if it is otherwise a legal target. Override Sand Veil, Snow Cloak, Hustle, and future authored accuracy factors for that recipient only; for an area attack, other recipients keep their own hit rules. This does not bypass range, line of sight, occupied-cell restrictions, protection, type immunity, absorption, or invalid commands, and it does not guarantee critical or secondary effects. The ability is continuous, self-involving, deterministic, and has no AP cost or duration. Share a final hit-context override across engine, preview, and AI, with no RNG draws for a guaranteed hit or UI inspection.

Name: Normalize
Description: All the Pokémon’s moves become Normal type. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's moves are changed to be Normal type and have their power multiplied by 1.2 (+20%). This effect comes before other effects that change a move's type. Gen 6 and earlier: no 20% power boost.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Build the pre-ability move profile from authored move/weather/item changes, then inspect active given before hidden slots. Normalize qualifies for every move; if it is the first eligible ability converter, replace its type with Normal and grant damaging moves one 1.2x base-power bonus. Only one ability conversion/bonus applies: Normalize given plus Dragonize hidden stays Normal; Dragonize given on a pre-ability Normal move plus Normalize hidden becomes Dragon. Status moves change type without gaining damage. Preserve AP, range, shape, category, tags, and effects. DEPENDENCY: implement this ordered temporary profile before validity/STAB/effectiveness/absorption, with shared previews and AI and separately authored future final overrides. Never mutate catalog moves or permanently replace equipped slots.

Name: Oblivious
Description: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Ignore infatuation, taunt, and Intimidate effects in their status and stat-change hooks.
Exact Description: This Pokémon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokémon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
Game Implementation: pokemon cannot be infatuated and protects againts captivate

Name: Opportunist
Description: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, raise the holder named stat through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: When an opposing Pokémon has a stat stage raised, this Pokémon copies the effect.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Whenever an opposing living unit receives a successful positive stage delta, apply the same actual accepted delta to this holder's matching supported stat after the original event resolves. Copy only the gained amount after the opponent's +/-6 cap; blocked or zero gains produce no event. Each copied change lasts five cycles, refreshes that stat's expiry, and obeys the holder's own stage guards/Contrary and cap. Mark the copied event so opposing Opportunist holders cannot loop indefinitely, and process multiple holders in stable battle-unit order. This is battlefield-wide, applies to all five existing stage stats, and grants no AP or extra action. Continuous multipliers and Curious Medicine resets are not stage gains and cannot be copied.

Name: Orichalcum Pulse
Description: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, raise the holder Attack through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: On entry, starts harsh sunlight for 5 turns, or 8 turns with a Heat Rock. While harsh sunlight is active, this Pokémon's Attack is multiplied by approximately 4/3 (about +33.33%). Sun also multiplies Fire-type damage by 1.5 (+50%) and Water-type damage by 0.5 (-50%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: At initial deployment, set ordinary sun for five global cycles (50,000 AV), replacing earlier ordinary weather in stable battle-unit order. While sun is effective, continuously multiply this holder's effective Attack by 4/3 in addition to normal sun's Fire damage x1.5 and Water damage x0.5 for everyone. The personal Attack bonus also works under sun created by another source, never stacks from repeated deployment evaluation, and ends on weather expiry/replacement or ability suppression. Eight-cycle Heat Rock extension requires an authored item modifier. Weather suppression disables both sun mechanics and the conditional bonus while the timer continues. This grants no stage, AP, or extra attack; use shared weather/damage previews and AV rescheduling for other sun-sensitive units.

Name: Overcoat
Description: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is immune to powder moves, damage from Sandstorm, and the effects of Rage Powder and the Effect Spore Ability.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Prevent all sandstorm residual HP damage to the holder regardless of its type, and reject incoming effects tagged powder or spore, including a future Effect Spore status proc and Rage Powder redirection. Do not block ordinary Grass moves, other statuses, snow, Burn, lava, or generic hazards simply because their visuals resemble dust. Qualification requires explicit move/ability metadata, not names or particle assets. The protection is continuous, self-only, deterministic, and unlimited while unsuppressed; it neither clears preexisting statuses nor changes weather duration. DEPENDENCY: add typed powder/spore tags and redirection guards before those effects are playable, while sandstorm immunity can use the current residual hook. Previews and AI must show exactly which effects are prevented.

Name: Overgrow
Description: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: When this Pokémon has 1/3 (33 1/3%) or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 (+50%) while using a Grass-type attack.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When the holder's HP is at or below floor(maximum HP/3), multiply the offensive stat used for its resolved Grass-type damaging move by 1.5. This threshold follows the supplied reference and requires explicit designer approval alongside the existing custom low-HP Blaze/Torrent choices; do not silently change their current rules. Physical moves use Attack and Special moves Special Attack after ordinary stages and items. Other types, Status moves, indirect damage, and HP above the threshold receive no bonus. Evaluate at move resolution for all area recipients, with no charge, duration, AP change, or RNG. Share the exact integer HP threshold and stat modifier with previews, inspection, and enemy scoring.

Name: Own Tempo
Description: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Prevent confusion and Intimidate effects from being applied to this unit.
Exact Description: This Pokémon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokémon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
Game Implementation: Prevent confusion and Intimidate effects from being applied to this unit.

Name: Parental Bond
Description: Parent and child each attacks.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Attack modifier in battle stat calculation while its condition is active.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's damaging moves become multi-hit moves that hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered (0.25x). Does not affect Doom Desire, Dragon Darts, Dynamax Cannon, Endeavor, Explosion, Final Gambit, Fling, Future Sight, Ice Ball, Rollout, Self-Destruct, any multi-hit move, any move that has multiple targets, or any two-turn move. Gen 6: the second hit dealt 1/2 (50%) of normal damage instead of 1/4 (25%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: add sequential multi-hit resolution, per-hit guard/reaction ordering, a reviewed excluded-move set from the Exact Description, and a saved move-event hit index. Eligible single-target, single-hit damaging moves resolve a normal first hit and, only if attacker/target remain alive, a second hit at 0.25x normal damage. Keep one AP payment and one Attack command; the second hit cannot recursively gain Parental Bond. Each hit checks current HP shields, contact, status, criticals, and immunity under the shared multi-hit policy, and both must be represented in previews. Area, existing multi-hit, charge/delayed, self-sacrifice, and listed special-formula moves are excluded. Do not approximate it as 1.25x power, which would misrepresent shields and reactions.

Name: Pastel Veil
Description: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described field or aura effect to the stated allies or opponents while the holder is deployed.
Exact Description: This Pokémon and its allies cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while this Pokémon or its ally is poisoned cures them. If this Ability is being ignored during an effect that causes poison, this Pokémon is cured immediately but its ally is not.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While a living unsuppressed holder is deployed, protect the holder and all living teammates across the battlefield from new ordinary or bad poison. When the aura first becomes active, immediately cure existing poison on those units once; later eligible poison attempts are prevented, while other statuses and existing negative stages remain unchanged. Multiple sources do not stack. Losing the last source removes protection without restoring old poison. DEPENDENCY: implement poison identity, bad-poison counter, shared cure/status guards, and ability-overlay activation events. Ordinary poison deals ceil(maximum HP/8) per global cycle until cured or battle end; this ability blocks both versions. Source-ignore exceptions must be handled per recipient, so a bypassed ally is not silently cured by an ignored aura.

Name: Perish Body
Description: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: A contact hit starts a Perish Song countdown on this Pokémon and its attacker. Each faints after 3 turns unless it switches out first. Does not start a second countdown if the attacker already has a perish count.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION FOR REVIEW: after a successful contact damaging hit leaves both holder and attacker alive, place a linked three-cycle perish countdown on both. They faint at the deadline unless they separate to more than 5 Manhattan tiles before it; moving or forced displacement can break the link, replacing the absent switch-out escape. Cancel both marks if either participant faints early, and never refresh an existing countdown through repeated contact. Each holder can maintain one link; apply no mark to an already marked attacker. DEPENDENCY: add saved linked deadlines, movement checks, visible tether/countdown previews, indirect-KO settlement, and status immunity policy. No AP or immediate extra action is granted, and battle end clears all marks.

Name: Pickpocket
Description: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: After a complete successful contact damaging move leaves this holder alive, if it is empty-handed and the attacker has an eligible transferable held item, move that item into the holder's battle slot once. Misses, immunity, Long Reach, damage-only chains, and an already occupied slot prevent theft. DEPENDENCY: add item-transfer metadata, provenance, reapplication of passive item effects, and shared settlement rules; unremovable form equipment and compatible Mega Stones are excluded. Proposed settlement returns the item to its original owner after battle, matching Magician's tactical policy and preventing inventory duplication. Future multi-hit moves resolve theft after their full sequence, and Sheer Force cancellation requires explicit move metadata. The ability grants no AP or extra Attack action.

Name: Pickup
Description: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Resolve in the route reward phase; grant the described item or benefit and record it in run inventory.
Exact Description: At the end of each turn, if this Pokémon is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokémon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokémon is selected at random and this Pokémon obtains that Pokémon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokémon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up. After a battle, if this Pokémon holds no item, it has a 10% chance to find an item. The possible items and their individual chances depend on the game and, from Emerald onward, this Pokémon's level.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: add consumed-item claims/provenance and populate the empty curated Item/Chance table. At an empty-handed holder's turn end, choose uniformly with seeded combat RNG one recoverable item consumed since its previous turn ended by a unit within 1 Manhattan tile. Claim it once across Pickup/Ball Fetch; destroyed/stolen/previously claimed items are excluded. Recovered items are temporary: discard unused copies at settlement, never refund the already-consumed original, and prevent further restoration/recovery of a consumed recovered instance. Separately, each deployed surviving empty-handed holder gets one seeded 10% post-battle roll and weighted table draw; successful finds enter the Bag with saved settlement IDs. No table means no playable reward branch. Recovery grants no AP and must be previewable without RNG.

Name: Piercing Drill
Description: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's contact moves bypass the target's protection. Against a protected target, the move deals 1/4 (25%) of the damage it would normally deal. Against an unprotected target, damage is unchanged. Other applicable move and contact effects still occur.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: For this holder's damaging moves whose resolved tags include contact, bypass an explicitly authored target protection effect and apply 0.25x of otherwise calculated damage against that protected recipient. Against unprotected recipients, deal ordinary damage. Other eligible on-hit secondary and contact effects still resolve, subject to their normal guards; this does not bypass type immunity, absorption, distance, line of sight, screens, or map cover. Long Reach removes contact and therefore removes eligibility. DEPENDENCY: implement typed Protect-style guards, distinguish complete protection from ordinary damage reduction, and share the override with previews and AI. Apply once per target hit without granting another Attack, refunding AP, or changing protection duration; non-contact moves remain blocked normally.

Name: Pixilate
Description: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2 (+20%). This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects. Gen 6: the power multiplier was 1.3 (+30%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Derive the pre-ability move type from authored move/weather/item changes, then inspect active given before hidden slots. Pixilate qualifies only for pre-ability Normal moves; if it is the first eligible converter, replace the type with Fairy and grant damaging moves one 1.2x base-power bonus. Earlier eligible converters win, and no later conversion or bonus stacks. Status moves change type without gaining damage or effects. Apply the final profile to STAB, immunity, terrain, absorption, targeting, previews, and AI while preserving AP, range, area, category, delivery, and tags. DEPENDENCY: add ordered temporary resolved-move hooks and separately authored final overrides for future Electrify/Ion Deluge; never edit catalog or equipped move identities.

Name: Plus
Description: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, raise the holder named stat through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokémon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5 (+50%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While another living allied unit has an active unsuppressed Plus or Minus ability, multiply this holder's effective Special Attack by 1.5. Scope is battlefield-wide; neither its own other slot nor a fainted/suppressed ally satisfies the condition. Multiple qualifying allies produce the same single multiplier and never accumulate stages or refresh timers. The benefit disappears immediately when the last qualifying ally is lost and returns if a real qualifying source later becomes active. It affects only this holder's Special damage through its offensive stat, with no AP cost, range change, or extra Attack command. Read both active ability slots through shared helpers and apply the identical condition in pure damage, inspection, previews, and enemy scoring.

Name: Poison Heal
Description: If poisoned, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is poisoned, it restores 1/8 (12.5%) of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn instead of losing HP.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While the holder is poisoned or badly poisoned, replace its normal poison residual damage at each global cycle boundary with healing equal to ceil(maximum HP/8), minimum 1 and capped at maximum HP. The poison status remains active for other abilities and can still be cured; badly poison's counter advances normally but never increases Poison Heal's flat recovery. No extra heal occurs at every holder turn, when poison is newly applied, or when a tick was already processed. DEPENDENCY: add poison/bad-poison status, counter, residual replacement ordering, and cure guards. Suppression restores ordinary poison damage from the next tick without resetting the counter. Other statuses and weather damage are unchanged; clear the battle-only poison state after combat.

Name: Poison Point
Description: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: 30% chance a Pokémon making contact with this Pokémon will be poisoned.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: After a successful contact-tagged damaging hit, use the defender's hit snapshot to make one seeded 30% roll to poison the living attacker, even if the holder fainted. Misses, immunity, damage-only chains, and Long Reach prevent it. DEPENDENCY: implement poison as a battle-only major status dealing ceil(maximum HP/8), minimum 1, at each global cycle boundary until cure or battle end. Poison/Steel types reject it unless the inflicting holder has active Corrosion; Pastel Veil and other guards still apply. Reapplying poison does not stack damage or reset bad-poison progression. Apply shared status guards before RNG when possible, show the chance/tick without preview rolls, and settle the reaction before battle results.

Name: Poison Puppeteer
Description: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
Proposed: PROPOSED: When this unit poisons a target with its move, also apply confusion through the status hook.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is a Pecharunt and poisons or badly poisons a target, the target also becomes confused.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: register compatible Pecharunt, poison/bad-poison events, and typed confusion with saved activations. When this holder successfully poisons a target through its own move, attempt confusion on that recipient at 100%; blocked/redundant poison creates no trigger. Proposed confusion lasts three target activations, each with a 1/3 seeded chance to replace an attempted Attack with a 40-power typeless Physical self-hit; this tactical definition needs designer review. The attempt still spends the selected move's full AP cost and Attack flag, preventing retries; Move/Special remain otherwise legal. Existing confusion is not extended, and Own Tempo/Misty guards apply. Other allies', hazard, and item poison do not trigger it. Show the chance and self-hit consequence without preview RNG.

Name: Poison Touch
Description: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning. This effect comes after a move's inherent secondary effect chance.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: After this holder's successful contact damaging hit applies its move's ordinary secondary effects, make one independent seeded 30% roll to poison that living recipient. Apply once per primary recipient event, including each area target actually contacted; Long Reach, misses, immunity, and damage-only chains prevent the trigger. DEPENDENCY: add battle-only poison with ceil(maximum HP/8), minimum 1, damage at global cycle boundaries until cure or battle end, plus shared type/immunity guards. Corrosion can bypass Poison/Steel type immunity but not Pastel Veil or equivalent protection. Existing poison does not stack or overwrite bad-poison progression. The ability grants no AP or extra Attack; show its independent chance and effect ordering in previews and logs.

Name: Power Construct
Description: Other Cells gather to aid when its HP becomes half or less. Then the Pokémon changes its form to Complete Forme.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At half HP or less, switch this unit to its registered Complete Forme once per battle.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is a Zygarde in its 10% or 50% Forme, it changes to Complete Forme when it has 1/2 (50%) or less of its maximum HP at the end of the turn.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: register Zygarde 10%, 50%, and Complete forms with reviewed stats/mobility/ability compatibility, saved transformation state, and reversible battle profiles. At the end of a compatible living holder's own turn, if its HP is at or below half maximum and it has not transformed this battle, change to Complete Forme once. Recompute intrinsic stats at its current level and rank exactly once, preserve missing HP by adding the maximum-HP increase to current HP, and never revive a fainted unit. Retain position, AP, moves, stages with their expiries, and ordinary action limits; reschedule waiting AV proportionally if Speed changes. Restore owned species after battle with explicit HP reconciliation, and preview the threshold/form change before Pass.

Name: Power of Alchemy
Description: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described field or aura effect to the stated allies or opponents while the holder is deployed.
Exact Description: This Pokémon copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When a living teammate faints, after its KO reactions but before result settlement, copy that teammate's effective given ability into the battle slot supplying this holder's Power of Alchemy. If the given ability is in the Exact Description's uncopyable list or would duplicate the holder's other active slot, make no change and never substitute the hidden ability. For simultaneous allied KOs, use stable battle-unit order and take the first eligible ability once; the replacement lasts until battle end. DEPENDENCY: add copyability metadata, slot provenance, shared activation overlays, and saved temporary replacements. Do not replay deployment triggers or mutate owned ability choices; continuous effects begin immediately, with matching previews, feedback, and proportional Speed rescheduling.

Name: Power Spot
Description: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's allies have the power of their moves multiplied by 1.3 (+30%). This affects Doom Desire and Future Sight, even if the user is not on the field.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While this living holder is deployed, multiply every other living teammate's damaging move power by 1.3 across the battlefield. Exclude the holder, enemies, Status moves, and indirect damage. Multiple Power Spot holders provide only one Power Spot multiplier per recipient; combine separately with the authored Battery special-move bonus. Reevaluate recipients immediately after fainting or ability changes, without persistent stages or an activation roll. Delayed attacks require a future delayed-action source snapshot contract; until then apply only to ordinary and existing damage-only chain calculations. Preview and AI use the same active aura.

Name: Prankster
Description: Gives priority to the Pokémon's status moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokémon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: Since the AV scheduler has no priority brackets, after this holder successfully pays for its one Status-category Attack, advance its next scheduled action by 2,500 AV, capped at the current battle time. Activate once per holder turn; retain the listed AP cost and normal Move/Attack limits. Prevent that Status move's effects on opposing Dark-type recipients, including recipients of a future called move, while allowing self/allied effects. Add recipient-level Status interception because current cast effects bypass damage hit checks. No roll is needed; show the timeline advance before confirmation and clear queued temporary shifts at battle end.

Name: Pressure
Description: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: When an opponent targets this unit, add an AP surcharge in move validation; set its amount during balance tuning.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is the target of an opposing Pokémon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokémon, but Sticky Web does not.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: Replace unavailable PP loss with an AP surcharge. A move intentionally targeting an opposing living Pressure holder costs 1 additional AP; an area move costs only 1 extra AP if its confirmed footprint includes one or more opposing Pressure holders. Calculate the surcharge once before payment, never once per holder or hit, and reject confirmation if total AP is unaffordable. Self buffs and empty areas pay no surcharge. Revalidate the displayed total when targets change; misses and absorption still spend it. Preserve 3 AP gain, banking, and one Attack per turn. This adaptation requires balance review.

Name: Primordial Sea
Description: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.
Proposed: PROPOSED: On deployment, set the specified weather through the battle weather-state hook.
Exact Description: On switch-in, the weather becomes Heavy Rain, which includes all the effects of Rain and prevents damaging Fire-type moves from executing. This weather remains in effect until this Ability is no longer active for any Pokémon, or the weather is changed by the Delta Stream or Desolate Land Abilities.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add a source-owned primal-weather layer above the existing five ordinary weather values. A living active holder forces rain modifiers and prevents execution of damaging Fire moves; rejected commands spend no AP. The layer lasts while at least one unsuppressed holder remains, with no cycle expiry. Desolate Land and Delta Stream can replace it using most-recent activation, tied by stable deployment order. Ordinary weather commands cannot override the layer. When its final source disappears, return to clear rather than resurrect expired weather. Implement weather-source persistence and shared legality, preview, AI, and scheduler handling before enabling this ability.

Name: Prism Armor
Description: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon receives 3/4 (75%) damage from supereffective attacks.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: In the shared damage calculation, multiply incoming direct attack damage to this holder by 0.75 when the move's resolved type effectiveness against its current types exceeds 1. Apply separately to every area recipient and damage-only chain target, after effectiveness and before final minimum-one rounding. Neutral, resisted, immune, weather, burn, lava, and hazard damage receive no reduction. There is no roll, duration, cooldown, or stored stage; the condition is reevaluated for each hit. Treat this as an unignorable defensive ability when defining Teravolt/Turboblaze bypass metadata, and show its reduced damage in previews.

Name: Propeller Tail
Description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Ignore opposing move-redirection effects when selecting and resolving this unit target.
