Exact Description: This Pokémon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add a shared redirection phase before resolving single-unit moves. Moves used by this holder retain the confirmed legal target and ignore attraction abilities and future redirection effects, while normal range, line of sight, immunity, protection, and accuracy checks still apply. The rule does not enlarge an area footprint or prevent reflected effects after impact. No activation roll, cost, timer, or cooldown is needed. The current engine has no redirection hook, so register this ability only with that shared hook and its preview/AI equivalent; do not represent it as already effective. Use the same contract as Stalwart.

Name: Protean
Description: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described type change in move or hit resolution and update the holder battle types for its stated duration.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokémon is not Terastallized. Gen 8 and earlier: type changes before every eligible move, without the once-per-entry restriction.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Once per battle, immediately before the holder's first successfully committed Attack, replace its battle types with the move's final resolved type. Resolve conversion abilities first, then Protean, then same-type damage bonus. Status moves qualify; invalid commands and cancellations do not consume the latch, but misses and immunity do. ADAPTATION: battle deployment replaces switch-in because no switching command exists. Keep the change until battle end, without altering movement capability, species, or either ability slot. Restore ordinary party types afterward. Save the used latch and battle type override; ability reacquisition cannot reset the once-per-battle allowance.

Name: Protosynthesis
Description: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, raise the holder named stat through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: If Sun is active or this Pokémon uses a held Booster Energy, this Pokémon's highest stat is multiplied by 1.3 (+30%), or by 1.5 if the highest stat is Speed. Stat stage changes are considered at the time this Ability activates. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order. If this effect was started by Sun, a held Booster Energy will not activate and the effect ends when Sun is no longer active. If this effect was started by a held Booster Energy, it ends when this Pokémon is no longer active.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When effective sun begins affecting this holder, snapshot its highest staged Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed, using that order to break ties. Multiply the selected effective stat by 1.3, or Speed by 1.5, while sun continues; do not create stages or repeatedly choose a new stat. End on sun loss and allow a fresh selection on later sun activation. DEPENDENCY: Booster Energy needs a held-item consumption hook and saved activation source; a consumed item would sustain the snapshot until battle end. Suppressed weather cannot activate it. Speed changes must proportionally reschedule waiting AV, preserving AP gain.

Name: Psychic Surge
Description: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
Proposed: PROPOSED: On deployment, set Psychic Terrain in a new battle-terrain state and apply its field effects.
Exact Description: On entry, starts Psychic Terrain for 5 turns, or 8 turns if this Pokémon holds a Terrain Extender. Grounded Pokémon are protected from opposing priority moves, and their Psychic-type moves have 1.3x power (+30%). Gen 7: the power multiplier was 1.5x (+50%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Introduce one battlefield terrain-field slot separate from tile kind and weather. On initial deployment, create Psychic Terrain for 50,000 AV; Terrain Extender increases this to 80,000 AV only after item support. Grounded living units on both teams gain 1.3 Psychic damaging-move power and immunity to opposing priority-tagged moves. That protection requires explicit authored priority metadata and recipient checks; current Quick Attack has no priority rule, and ordinary AV advances are not equivalent. A new terrain replaces the old field; simultaneous deployment ties use stable roster order. Save source and expiry, derive grounding from shared combat mobility/Levitate/airborne overrides, and prevent recurring entry activation.

Name: Punk Rock
Description: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's sound-based moves have their power multiplied by 1.3 (+30%). This Pokémon takes halved (0.5x) damage from sound-based moves.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Multiply this holder's damaging sound-tagged move power by 1.3 and incoming sound-tagged attack damage by 0.5. Use the existing sound metadata rather than move names or ranged delivery; Howl remains a Status move and gains no damage bonus. Apply to each direct or chain damage calculation without changing AP cost, range, secondary effects, or normal sound-move immunity. No activation roll or timer applies, and sound damage from different attackers is checked independently. Soundproof intercepts eligible moves before this reduction. Exclude weather, burn, and terrain damage; previews and enemy scoring must share both multipliers.

Name: Pure Power
Description: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's Attack is doubled (2x).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Double this living holder's effective Attack for Physical damage calculations, after its current Attack stage and intrinsic level/rank values are determined. Treat this as an effective-stat modifier, not an Attack stage, so stage clearing and five-cycle stage expiry cannot remove it. Do not affect Special Attack, movement, AP gain, or indirect damage. Apply continuously with no chance or cooldown while the ability is active, and remove immediately if replaced or suppressed. To prevent duplicate-equivalent stacking, Pure Power and Huge Power share one doubling family; combine independently with held-item Attack modifiers. Validate previews against actual Physical damage.

Name: Purifying Salt
Description: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. If a Pokémon uses a Ghost-type attack against this Pokémon, that Pokémon's offensive stat is halved (0.5x) when calculating the damage to this Pokémon.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Reject incoming burn and paralysis before application, and halve the attacker's effective offensive stat only when calculating Ghost-type damage to this holder. Other recipients of an area move are unchanged; Ghost immunity still yields zero. DEPENDENCY: sleep, poison, freeze, escalating poison, and Yawn require a typed status framework, with this ability registered as preventing each and cancelling pending Yawn. Proposed review choice: acquiring the ability cures existing major statuses rather than leaving a disabled timer. No chance, cooldown, or persistent buff is involved. Keep weather, hazards, displacement, stat stages, and other volatile effects outside this protection.

Name: Quark Drive
Description: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, raise the holder named stat through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: If Electric Terrain is active or this Pokémon uses a held Booster Energy, this Pokémon's highest stat is multiplied by 1.3 (+30%), or by 1.5 if the highest stat is Speed. Stat stage changes are considered at the time this Ability activates. If multiple stats are tied, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed are prioritized in that order. If this effect was started by Electric Terrain, a held Booster Energy will not activate and the effect ends when Electric Terrain is no longer active. If this effect was started by a held Booster Energy, it ends when this Pokémon is no longer active.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add Electric Terrain as a saved battlefield field and Booster Energy as a consumable held item. When either activates this ability, snapshot the highest staged Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed; ties use that order. Multiply the chosen effective stat by 1.3, or Speed by 1.5. Terrain activation ends when effective Electric Terrain ends; consumed Booster Energy instead lasts until battle end, and is not consumed while terrain already powers the effect. Reevaluate the chosen stat only on fresh activation. Prevent double activation from both sources, reschedule Speed changes, and expose the source and selected stat in inspection.

Name: Queenly Majesty
Description: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: Priority moves used by opposing Pokémon targeting this Pokémon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: Extend authored Dazzling protection to the holder and living teammates within a five-tile Manhattan radius. Opposing moves with authored range at least 6 cannot affect those recipients, regardless of attacker distance. Check base range before elevation, Compound Eyes, or Armor Tail adjustments. Intercept damage and recipient-targeted Status effects before hit rolls, while other area recipients remain eligible. Show the protected aura; movement, fainting, or suppression updates it immediately. Multiple Queenly Majesty sources provide one protection, not stacked range penalties. This deliberately replaces absent priority rules and needs balance review; previews and AI must use the same recipient-level immunity.

Name: Quick Draw
Description: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: This Pokémon has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: Once at this holder's turn start, roll a seeded 30% Quick Draw opportunity and show the result. If the holder commits a damaging Attack that turn, consume the opportunity to advance its next scheduled action by 2,500 AV, capped at current time. A Status move or Pass expires it without benefit; attacks still pay full AP and use the normal single Attack allowance. This substitutes a concrete AV advantage for unavailable priority brackets without granting an extra current-turn action. Save the rolled opportunity before interaction so reloads cannot reroll it; previews read the saved state and consume no RNG.

Name: Quick Feet
Description: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon has a status condition.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon has a non-volatile status condition, its Speed is multiplied by 1.5 (+50%). This Pokémon ignores the paralysis effect of halving Speed.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While this holder has an active major status, multiply its effective Speed by 1.5 and ignore only paralysis's usual 0.5 Speed penalty. Current burn and paralysis timers qualify; other statuses require the future typed status contract. Recalculate immediately on status application, removal, expiry, or ability suppression, proportionally rescheduling a waiting unit's remaining AV. Do not grant AP, cure the status, remove burn damage, or bypass a future sleep action restriction. No roll, stage, or independent duration applies. Trick Room uses the resulting effective Speed normally, and inspection/previews must display the same scheduler value.

Name: Rain Dish
Description: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described field or aura effect to the stated allies or opponents while the holder is deployed.
Exact Description: If Rain is active, this Pokémon restores 1/16 (6.25%) of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. This effect is prevented if this Pokémon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: At each global 10,000-AV cycle boundary, if this living holder is below maximum HP and effective rain is active, heal ceil(maximum HP / 16), minimum 1, capped at missing HP. ADAPTATION: use cycle ticks and the game's ceiling HP convention rather than per-Pokémon turns and reference flooring. Process once per boundary, after harmful residual damage and only if the holder survives; no healing on deployment or ordinary turn start. Weather suppression disables the trigger without removing rain. DEPENDENCY: Utility Umbrella needs explicit item metadata before it can opt the holder out. No roll or banking of missed ticks.

Name: Rattled
Description: The Pokémon gets scared when hit by a Dark-, Ghost-, or Bug-type attack or if intimidated, which boosts its Speed stat.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add an incoming-hit hook; check the described move or damage condition, then apply its prevention, healing, or stat response.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's Speed is raised by 1 stage if hit by a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type attack, or if an opposing Pokémon affected this Pokémon with the Intimidate Ability.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: After this holder survives positive direct damage from a Bug-, Dark-, or Ghost-type move, raise its Speed by 1 stage, capped at +6, and refresh Speed's expiry to 50,000 AV after that hit. Trigger once per incoming move, including a qualifying area hit, without a random roll; damage-only chains are excluded from post-hit reactions consistently with current chain rules. Also trigger once when an opposing Intimidate aura newly affects the holder, even if Attack reduction is prevented. Leaving and reentering that aura can trigger again. Immediately reschedule waiting AV and clear temporary stages at battle end.

Name: Receiver
Description: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described field or aura effect to the stated allies or opponents while the holder is deployed.
Exact Description: This Pokémon copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add battle-only ability replacement on a teammate faint event. A living holder replaces only its Receiver-bearing slot with the fallen teammate's effective given ability, provided that ability is copyable and differs from the holder's other active slot. Use the supplied exclusion table; never fall back to a hidden ability if given is ineligible. For simultaneous fainting, choose stable deployment order. Copies last until battle end, preserving ordinary party assignments and the other slot. Reconcile auras/speed and run only acquisition-specific hooks, never deployment-only bonuses. Persist the override; no random roll, resurrection, reserve deployment, or permanent ability change occurs. Match Power of Alchemy exactly.

Name: Reckless
Description: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have their power multiplied by 1.2 (+20%). Does not affect Struggle.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add authored recoil/crash traits and distinguish move recoil from item/residual damage. Multiply this holder's damaging move power by 1.2 if it has genuine recoil or miss-crash metadata; exclude Struggle and self-sacrifice moves. Apply at commitment even if Rock Head later prevents recoil. Keep the authored recoil fraction/formula unchanged; damage-based recoil still recalculates from increased actual damage, while crash follows its own rule. Do not add contact or change AP. No chance, timer, or cooldown applies. Gate availability until compatible moves and recoil resolution exist, with shared traits and self-damage forecasts in previews, AI, and combat.

Name: Refrigerate
Description: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2 (+20%). This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects. Gen 6: the power multiplier was 1.3 (+30%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Derive each move's pre-ability type after authored weather/item changes, then inspect the holder's given and hidden slots in order. The first eligible move-type replacement wins: Refrigerate qualifies only for pre-ability Normal moves, converts them to Ice, and gives damaging moves one 1.2 power bonus. Status moves convert without power. Do not apply a second conversion or bonus from the other slot; Normalize-first therefore keeps Normal. Preserve range, AP, area, delivery, tags, and effects; compute immunity, same-type bonus, and Protean afterward using final type. No roll, timer, or cooldown applies. Use one resolved-move object consistently in previews, AI, and combat.

Name: Regenerator
Description: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Restore the described HP when this unit leaves the active battle field through a switch action.
Exact Description: This Pokémon restores 1/3 (33 1/3%) of its maximum HP, rounded down, when it switches out.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: At the end of a living holder's own turn, heal ceil(maximum HP / 6), minimum 1 and capped at missing HP, if it used neither its Move nor its Attack command that turn. Special actions may still be used, but healing activates only once when the turn actually ends and never on intermediate UI updates. This rewards resting in place while retaining AP banking; it adds no switch, retreat, or reserve deployment command. No chance or cycle timer applies. Save turn command-use flags, prevent additional end-turn calls from duplicating healing, and review the smaller rest-based fraction against recovery items.

Name: Ripen
Description: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Double Berry effects before applying their healing or stat change, then consume them normally.
Exact Description: When this Pokémon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled (2x). Berries that restore HP or PP have the amount doubled (2x), Berries that raise stat stages have the amount doubled (2x), Berries that halve damage taken quarter it instead, and a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry has the attacker lose 1/4 (25%) of its maximum HP, rounded down.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When this holder actually consumes its Sitrus Berry, double the normal recovery fraction from one quarter to one half maximum HP, then heal ceil(maximum HP / 2), minimum 1 and capped at missing HP. Consume exactly one Berry and allow other consumption reactions such as Cheek Pouch afterward without doubling those separate abilities. No activation chance or extra AP cost applies. DEPENDENCY: other Berry families need typed item effects; double only their authored HP/PP amounts or stage deltas, square resistance multipliers, and define retaliation separately. Do not invent PP, stat Berries, or damage-resistance Berries before those systems exist.

Name: Rivalry
Description: The Pokémon's competitive spirit makes it deal more damage to Pokémon of the same gender, but less damage to Pokémon of the opposite gender.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's attacks have their power multiplied by 1.25 (+25%) against targets of the same gender or multiplied by 0.75 (-25%) against targets of the opposite gender. There is no modifier if either this Pokémon or the target is genderless.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: Replace unavailable gender comparisons with visible type rivalry: the holder's damaging move power is multiplied by 1.25 against a target sharing at least one current type, otherwise by 0.75. Reevaluate independently for each area/chain recipient after temporary type changes, with no random choice, cooldown, or timer. This deliberately makes the disadvantage universal outside shared-type matchups and requires balance review. Do not infer gender from species names or artwork. A faithful alternative requires saved per-Pokémon gender and genderless metadata; it should replace this rule entirely if selected. Previews must identify the shared-type condition before spending AP.

Name: RKS System
Description: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the memory disc it holds.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described type change in move or hit resolution and update the holder battle types for its stated duration.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is a Silvally, its type changes to match its held Memory.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add Silvally's reviewed form/type registry and equippable Memory item metadata. At battle creation, if this holder is Silvally, replace its battle typing with the held Memory's authored type; with no compatible Memory, use Normal. Reevaluate if a future legal held-item change occurs, and restore ordinary party identity at battle end. Do not change HP, AP, stages, movement capabilities, or the second ability slot merely because type changes. Non-Silvally Capsule recipients receive no effect. This is deterministic with no timer or activation roll; save the battle type override and expose the Memory/type relationship in loadout inspection before enabling it.

Name: Rock Head
Description: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon does not take recoil damage, except Struggle. Does not affect Life Orb damage or crash damage.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Define a move-recoil damage event separate from crash, item, weather, terrain, and self-sacrifice damage. Prevent that event for this holder at 100% reliability, except recoil specifically authored for Struggle. Keep the attack's damage, AP cost, hit chance, and secondary effects unchanged; a missed recoil move still follows its own crash rule. Rock Head cannot block burn, sandstorm, lava, future Life Orb damage, or deliberate HP payments. No cooldown or stored duration applies. Gate availability until recoil-capable moves and shared damage-cause metadata are implemented, with previews showing prevented recoil and enemy scoring using identical rules.

Name: Rocky Payload
Description: Powers up Rock-type moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 (+50%) while using a Rock-type attack.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Multiply this holder's effective offensive stat by 1.5 only while calculating damage from a resolved Rock-type move. Use Attack for Physical moves and Special Attack for Special moves, after the appropriate stage and intrinsic rank values; do not modify stored stats or other move types. Evaluate separately for every area and chain recipient, while normal Rock immunity/resistance, same-type bonus, criticals, and sandstorm effects remain independent. There is no chance, timer, or cooldown. This matches the supplied offensive-stat rule rather than reusing a final damage multiplier; previews and actual fixed-point rounding must follow the same calculation.

Name: Rough Skin
Description: The Pokémon's rough skin damages attackers that make direct contact with it.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: Pokémon making contact with this Pokémon lose 1/8 (12.5%) of their maximum HP, rounded down. Gen 3: contact damage was 1/16 (6.25%) of the attacker's maximum HP.
Game Implementation: after contact damage, deal 1/8 max hp damage to the attacker

Name: Run Away
Description: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a route encounter retreat action and resolve its success when this ability is present.
Exact Description: Guarantees successful escape from a wild battle, including when a trapping move or Ability would normally prevent fleeing. Does not allow switching out of a Trainer battle or bypass Trainer-battle escape restrictions.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: Once per battle, let this holder ignore movement-trapping ability restrictions during one ordinary Move. At a trapped own-turn start, offer an escape entitlement valid for that turn; Pass/turn end expires an unused offer without spending the once-battle allowance, and later trapped turns may offer again. Consume only on committed Move, never cancellation. Movement still costs 1 AP and obeys Movement range, walls, occupancy, elevation, hazards, and the one-Move limit. This neither ends battle nor deploys reserves. A faithful wild-battle escape requires a separately designed escape/outcome system. Save committed use and display the entitlement; review this tactical substitute.

Name: Sand Force
Description: Boosts the power of Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves in a sandstorm.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokémon's Ground-, Rock-, and Steel-type attacks have their power multiplied by 1.3 (+30%). This Pokémon takes no damage from Sandstorm.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While effective sandstorm is active, multiply the power of this holder's Ground-, Rock-, and Steel-type damaging moves by 1.3. Independently prevent its sandstorm residual HP damage even if its current types are not normally immune. Do not prevent lava, burn, entry hazards, or other weather effects, and do not add Rock's sandstorm Special Defense bonus to non-Rock types. Reevaluate per hit and per global cycle tick, without stages, rolls, or cooldown. Weather suppression removes the power bonus and already disables weather damage. Apply the same condition to area/chain previews and enemy scoring; remove immediately if the ability is lost.

Name: Sand Rush
Description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokémon's Speed is doubled (2x). This Pokémon takes no damage from Sandstorm.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Double this holder's effective Speed while effective sandstorm is active, and prevent its sandstorm residual damage regardless of current typing. Entering or leaving sandstorm, weather suppression, or losing the ability must proportionally reschedule a waiting unit's remaining AV; the active unit's next interval uses the new Speed. Keep normal Speed stages, paralysis, and Trick Room composition, fixed 3 AP gain, and one Move/Attack limit. No random roll, stage, cooldown, or independent timer applies. The immunity affects sandstorm ticks only, not burn, lava, or hazards. Show the effective Speed and updated queue consistently in previews.

Name: Sand Spit
Description: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add an incoming-hit hook; check the described move or damage condition, then apply its prevention, healing, or stat response.
Exact Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a damaging move, starts a sandstorm for 5 turns, or 8 turns if this Pokémon holds a Smooth Rock. Sandstorm damages Pokémon that are not immune by 1/16 (6.25%) of their maximum HP per turn and multiplies Rock-type Pokémon's Special Defense by 1.5 (+50%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: After an ordinary incoming move deals positive damage to this holder, use the hit snapshot to replace ordinary weather with sandstorm lasting 50,000 AV, even if that hit faints the holder. Repeated qualifying attacks refresh expiry; trigger once per incoming move without a roll, excluding indirect damage and existing damage-only chains. Retain existing Rock Special Defense and cycle-chip rules. DEPENDENCY: Smooth Rock metadata may extend this to 80,000 AV; primal-weather source ownership must decide whether the change is blocked. Weather changes immediately reschedule affected waiting units. Resolve simultaneous reactions in stable target/deployment order and show the new duration in feedback.

Name: Sand Stream
Description: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm when it enters a battle.
Proposed: PROPOSED: On deployment, set the specified weather through the battle weather-state hook.
Exact Description: On entry, starts a sandstorm for 5 turns, or 8 turns if this Pokémon holds a Smooth Rock. Sandstorm damages Pokémon that are not immune by 1/16 (6.25%) of their maximum HP per turn and multiplies Rock-type Pokémon's Special Defense by 1.5 (+50%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Once on battle deployment, this holder sets ordinary sandstorm for 50,000 AV, replacing the map weather and its expiry. Use the current sandstorm damage and Rock Special Defense rules. If several deployment weather setters activate together, process stable roster order and let the final legal setter win; no random roll applies. Fainting later does not end the timed weather. DEPENDENCY: Smooth Rock metadata extends the duration to 80,000 AV only after that item exists; primal-weather locking needs the shared weather-source contract. Temporary suppression ends this activation without automatically replaying it. Recalculate weather-dependent Speed and queue predictions immediately.

Name: Sand Veil
Description: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in a sandstorm.
Proposed: CURRENT RULES: Apply the sandstorm hit-chance modifier before attack resolution.
Exact Description: If Sandstorm is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokémon is multiplied by 0.8 (-20%). This Pokémon takes no damage from Sandstorm.
Game Implementation: Apply the sandstorm hit-chance modifier before attack resolution (all moves on this pokemon become 80% accurate)

Name: Sap Sipper
Description: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Grass-type moves. Instead, its Attack stat is boosted.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add an incoming-hit hook; check the described move or damage condition, then apply its prevention, healing, or stat response.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is immune to Grass-type moves and raises its Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Grass-type move.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When a Grass-type move successfully reaches this holder, intercept it before damage or negative move effects, grant Attack +1, and refresh Attack's five-cycle expiry. This includes damaging attacks and future targeted Grass Status moves; the latter require recipient-level Status interception because current cast effects bypass absorption. Trigger once per move aimed at the holder, without a roll, capped at +6; misses do not trigger it. Do not redirect Grass moves, change AP payment, heal, or protect teammates. A matching given/hidden absorption resolves only once using slot order. Keep previews, enemy scoring, and battle feedback aligned with the immunity.

Name: Schooling
Description: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: On switch-in, if this Pokémon is a Wishiwashi that is level 20 or above and has more than 1/4 (25%) of its maximum HP left, it changes to School Form. If it is in School Form and its HP drops to 1/4 (25%) of its maximum HP or less, it changes to Solo Form at the end of the turn. If it is in Solo Form and its HP is greater than 1/4 (25%) its maximum HP at the end of the turn, it changes to School Form.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Register Wishiwashi Solo/School forms with reviewed stats, types, sprites, and safe battle form replacement. At deployment and the end of each holder turn, a level-20-or-higher Wishiwashi uses School Form above 25% maximum HP and Solo Form at or below 25%; lower levels remain Solo. Recalculate level/rank stats once, preserve HP percentage with a documented rounding rule, and reschedule Speed without changing AP or equipped moves. Non-Wishiwashi recipients do nothing. No roll or cooldown applies; healing can restore School Form on a later check. Save the temporary form and restore ordinary party species after battle; no switching mechanic is required.

Name: Scrappy
Description: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Let this unit Normal and Fighting attacks hit Ghost targets and ignore Intimidate Attack reduction.
Exact Description: This Pokémon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. This Pokémon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: For this holder's Normal- and Fighting-type attacks, ignore the Ghost component's zero effectiveness while retaining the target's other type factors and all non-Ghost immunities. Calculate same-type bonus and damage normally, with no accuracy increase or extra AP cost. Also reject Attack drops whose source is opposing Intimidate, including new entries into its authored five-tile Manhattan aura; other stat reductions remain legal. This is continuous, deterministic protection with no cooldown, timer, or stage of its own. Handle the type exception in shared matchup, preview, AI, and actual damage paths so immune tiles and damage forecasts do not contradict combat.

Name: Screen Cleaner
Description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described field or aura effect to the stated allies or opponents while the holder is deployed.
Exact Description: On switch-in, the effects of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, and Reflect end for both sides.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: Once on deployment, clear active coverUntil effects across the battlefield for both teams, preserving mud, damaging hazards, tile kinds, elevation, stages, and weather. DEPENDENCY: current maps start without temporary cover, which Rock Throw creates only later, so gate ability availability until initial-cover content or team screen fields are authored; this has no present deployment benefit. If Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are added, the same event removes those fields too. Resolve in stable deployment order and log cleared fields. No roll, AP cost, continuing aura, or switching command applies, and later screens do not disappear automatically.

Name: Seed Sower
Description: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add an incoming-hit hook; check the described move or damage condition, then apply its prevention, healing, or stat response.
Exact Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a damaging move, starts Grassy Terrain for 5 turns, or 8 turns if this Pokémon holds a Terrain Extender. Grounded Pokémon recover 1/16 (6.25%) of their maximum HP each turn, and their Grass-type moves have 1.3x power (+30%). Earthquake, Bulldoze, and Magnitude deal half damage to grounded targets.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add a saved Grassy Terrain field independent of tile kind. After an ordinary move damages this holder, create that field for 50,000 AV even if the holder faints; later qualifying hits refresh expiry. Terrain Extender permits 80,000 AV after item support. Grounded units on either side heal ceil(maximum HP / 16), capped, each global cycle and gain 1.3 Grass move power. Authored Earthquake/Bulldoze/Magnitude damage against grounded recipients is halved. Use shared combat-grounded status, including Levitate and airborne overrides independently of traversal. Exclude residual damage and damage-only chains from activation. New terrain replaces old terrain; implement hit snapshots, field expiry, previews, and save validation before enabling.

Name: Serene Grace
Description: Raises the likelihood of additional effects occurring when the Pokémon uses its moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Increase secondary-effect activation chances for this unit moves in move-effect resolution.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's moves have their secondary effect chance doubled (2x). This effect stacks with the Rainbow effect, except for secondary effects that cause the target to flinch.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Double each authored probabilistic secondary move-effect chance for this holder, capped at 100%, after a successful ordinary hit. Existing Ember burn becomes 50%, Thunderbolt paralysis becomes 50%, and Thunder Shock's chain opportunity becomes 60%. Guaranteed effects stay guaranteed; do not double Static, item triggers, critical rate, accuracy, damage variance, or a future Toxic Chain ability roll. Use one seeded roll per actual secondary opportunity and do not add effects to damage-only chain hits. Preserve listed durations, AP cost, and target selection. DEPENDENCY: classify primary versus secondary effects explicitly before new move families arrive; previews must display adjusted percentages without consuming RNG.

Name: Shadow Shield
Description: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved (0.5x).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: If this holder is at exactly maximum HP immediately before an incoming direct attack's damage calculation, halve that hit's damage. Evaluate per target and per hit; the first successful hit usually removes eligibility for later hits, while a miss or immunity does not. Healing back to full reactivates the condition without a cooldown. Exclude weather, burn, lava, hazards, HP payments, and other indirect damage. Apply after normal effectiveness and before minimum-one rounding, with no activation roll or stage. Mark this reduction unignorable in the future bypass registry. Shared previews and enemy scoring must reflect the holder's current HP precisely.

Name: Shadow Tag
Description: The Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadows to prevent them from fleeing or switching out.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Prevent opposing units from retreating or switching while this unit is deployed.
Exact Description: Prevents opposing Pokémon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell, are a Ghost type, or also have this Ability.
Game Implementation: Aura: Units within 5  tiles have them trapped and their movement reduced(enemies can only move to tiles within 5 tiles of the shadow tag unit once they've entered the area)

Name: Sharpness
Description: Powers up slicing moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's slicing moves have their power multiplied by 1.5 (+50%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add a reviewed slicing move trait to the move schema and catalog validation; do not infer it from Physical category, melee delivery, projectile, or contact tags. Multiply this holder's damaging slicing move power by 1.5, preserving type, AP cost, range, area, contact behavior, and secondary effects. A proposed first catalog review candidate is Razor Leaf; confirm its classification explicitly before granting the bonus. Apply to every eligible direct or chain damage calculation with no roll, cooldown, or timer. Conversion abilities change type without removing the slicing trait. Preview, enemy scoring, and combat must share the same authored tag check.

Name: Shed Skin
Description: The Pokémon may cure its own status conditions by shedding its skin.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the battle cycle tick, roll the described chance to clear this unit status condition.
Exact Description: This Pokémon has a 33% chance to have its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: At the end of each living holder turn, if it has at least one active major status, roll a single seeded 33% cure chance. Success removes burn and paralysis together; failure leaves their existing expiry unchanged. DEPENDENCY: future sleep, poison, freeze, and escalating-poison statuses must join the same typed cure operation, including their damage counters and action restrictions. Do not cure stat stages, Flash Fire charge, trapping, confusion, weather, or hazards. Trigger at most once when a turn actually ends, including a Pass; no extra roll on movement or Special actions. Reschedule Speed immediately when paralysis is cured, and show the cure in feedback.

Name: Sheer Force
Description: Removes any additional effects from the Pokémon's moves, but increases the moves' power.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's attacks with secondary effects have their power multiplied by 1.3 (+30%), but the secondary effects are removed. If a secondary effect was removed, it also removes the user's Life Orb recoil and Shell Bell recovery, and prevents the target's Anger Shell, Berserk, Color Change, Emergency Exit, Pickpocket, Wimp Out, Red Card, Eject Button, Kee Berry, and Maranga Berry from activating.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Multiply this holder's damaging move power by 1.3 when its authored effect list contains at least one removable secondary effect, then suppress those removable effects for the entire move. Explicitly classify probabilistic burn, paralysis, and chaining as removable; classify primary displacement and field creation separately rather than guessing from on-hit timing. No chance, timer, or cooldown applies. DEPENDENCY: shared metadata must mark removed effects and suppress listed reactive abilities/items only when that move qualified; unsupported Life Orb or Shell Bell behavior is gated until item support. Keep damage-only chain semantics, AP payment, and shared preview/AI calculations consistent with the resulting effect list.

Name: Shell Armor
Description: A hard shell protects the Pokémon from critical hits.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Prevent critical-hit bonuses in incoming damage calculation while this unit is active.
Exact Description: This Pokémon cannot be struck by a critical hit.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Prevent direct attacks against this holder from becoming critical hits, including each area recipient and existing damage-only chain. Apply the defender's no-critical flag before critical damage and stage-bypass decisions; do not merely divide an already critical result afterward. Retain normal accuracy, damage variance, type effectiveness, burn, and ability bonuses. The ability has no chance, timer, cooldown, or stored stage and stops immediately when lost or suppressed. Use the same protection family as authored Battle Armor so duplicate protection adds no benefit. Previews must show no critical damage band; the resolver should skip the otherwise unnecessary critical RNG draw deterministically.

Name: Shield Dust
Description: Protective dust shields the Pokémon from the additional effects of moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Suppress secondary move effects against this unit while preserving the move primary damage.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokémon's attack. Attacks with secondary effects that are prevented include those with a chance (even 100%) to paralyze, sleep, freeze, burn, poison, confuse, cause this Pokémon to flinch, cause this Pokémon's stat stages to be lowered, as well as Anchor Shot, Eerie Spell, Fling, Psychic Noise, Salt Cure, Spirit Shackle, Syrup Bomb, and Throat Chop. The effect of Sparkling Aria is prevented if this Pokémon is the only target. Secondary effects added by King's Rock, Razor Fang, and the Poison Touch, Stench, and Toxic Chain Abilities are also prevented against this Pokémon.
Game Implementation: Suppress secondary move effects against this unit while preserving the move primary damage.

Name: Shields Down
Description: When its HP drops to half or less, the Pokémon's shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At half HP, change this unit registered form and update its battle stats and types.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is a Minior, it changes to its Core forme if it has 1/2 (50%) or less of its maximum HP, and changes to Meteor Form if it has more than 1/2 (50%) its maximum HP. This check is done on switch-in and at the end of each turn. While in its Meteor Form, it cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Register Minior Meteor/Core forms and a battle-only form handler. At deployment and the end of each holder turn, Minior is Core at HP at or below 50% maximum and Meteor above 50%; healing can reverse the choice on a later check. Meteor prevents burn/paralysis and future major statuses/Yawn; acquiring Meteor does not automatically cure an existing status unless separately approved. Recalculate level/rank stats once, preserve a documented HP percentage, and reschedule Speed while retaining AP, moves, and the other slot. Non-Minior recipients have no effect. Persist form and status protection; restore ordinary party identity after battle, without switching.

Name: Simple
Description: Doubles the effects of the Pokémon's stat changes.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described named stat modifier in battle stat calculation while its condition is active.
Exact Description: When one of this Pokémon's stat stages is raised or lowered, the amount is doubled (2x).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Whenever a stage-changing effect applies to this holder's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, or Speed, double its signed delta before the normal -6 to +6 clamp. Thus Harden grants +2 and Tail Whip applies -2. Preserve the original expiry length; normal moves refresh the affected stat to five cycles. Apply only once per event even with two active slots, and do not double direct resets, copying final stage values, intrinsic rank multipliers, effective-stat abilities, or HP/movement. Define ordering before Contrary so one stage pipeline handles both. No roll or cooldown applies; previews and Speed rescheduling use the final clamped result.

Name: Skill Link
Description: Maximizes the number of times multistrike moves hit.
Proposed: PROPOSED: For moves marked multi-hit, always resolve their maximum listed hit count.
Exact Description: Multi-hit moves that normally hit 2-5 times always hit 5 times. Triple Kick and Triple Axel check accuracy only for the first hit, so all 3 hits occur if the first accuracy check succeeds. Population Bomb likewise checks accuracy once for up to 10 hits. Immunity and protection can still prevent hits.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Introduce authored multi-hit counts, one-versus-per-hit accuracy policy, per-hit damage, survival checks, and reaction limits before enabling this ability. For this holder, 2–5-hit moves always attempt five hits; Triple Kick/Triple Axel and Population Bomb instead use one initial accuracy check for their authored maximum sequence. Immunity, absorption, protection, or a fainted target stops or negates hits through explicit sequence rules. Each successful hit keeps its normal critical and variance rolls; no extra Attack or AP payment occurs. The ability has no timer or cooldown. Existing Thunder Shock chaining is a separate target effect and must never be mistaken for multi-hit damage.

Name: Slow Start
Description: For five turns, the Pokémon's Attack and Speed stats are halved.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: On switch-in, this Pokémon's Attack and Speed are halved (0.5x) for 5 turns.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: At battle deployment, apply battle-only 0.5 effective Attack and 0.5 effective Speed multipliers to this holder until battle time reaches deployment time plus 50,000 AV. These are continuous modifiers, not stages, so Curious Medicine cannot clear them; expiration removes both together and proportionally rescales remaining waiting AV. Preserve 3 AP per turn, banking, and the normal Move/Attack limits. No random roll applies. ADAPTATION: use five global cycles instead of five personal turns, and do not restart the timer after ability suppression or reacquisition. Save its original expiry so reloading cannot extend or bypass the penalty; battle end clears it.

Name: Slush Rush
Description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: If Snow is active, this Pokémon's Speed is doubled (2x). Gen 7-8: doubles Speed in hail instead of snow.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Double this holder's effective Speed while effective snow is active, using the existing snow weather rather than adding hail. Reevaluate on weather start, expiry, replacement, suppression, or ability loss, and proportionally reschedule waiting units' remaining AV whenever the multiplier changes. Speed stages and paralysis combine normally; Trick Room uses the resulting effective Speed, so faster can mean a longer wait there. Keep 3 AP gain, banking, Movement range, and action limits unchanged. No random roll, stage, cooldown, or independent timer applies. Snow already causes no chip damage; this ability adds no new immunity or Defense bonus to non-Ice types.

Name: Sniper
Description: If the Pokémon's attack lands a critical hit, the attack is powered up even further.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described critical-hit adjustment when calculating the holder attack chance.
Exact Description: Damage from this Pokémon's critical hits is multiplied by an additional 1.5x (+50%). With the normal Gen 6 onward critical multiplier of 1.5x, the combined critical multiplier is 2.25x. Gen 5 and earlier: normal criticals were 2x, so Sniper criticals were 3x.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When this holder scores a critical direct hit, multiply that critical damage by an additional 1.5, giving a combined 2.25 critical multiplier before damage variance with the current 1.5 baseline. Apply separately to each area and damage-only chain recipient that actually crits; ordinary hits gain no bonus. Do not increase the current 1-in-24 critical chance, bypass type immunity, or affect residual damage. No activation roll beyond the existing critical roll, duration, or cooldown is added. Defensive critical prevention wins before this modifier. Damage previews must display the enhanced critical band and enemy scoring must use the corresponding probability-weighted value.

Name: Snow Cloak
Description: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness in snow.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Lower attacks hit chance against this unit while snow weather is active.
Exact Description: If Snow is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokémon is multiplied by 0.8 (-20%). Gen 8 and earlier: activates in hail instead of snow and also prevents hail damage.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While effective snow is active, multiply incoming move hit chance against this holder by 0.8, using the same multiplicative evasion family as current Sand Veil. With otherwise certain accuracy, each damaging hit has an 80% chance to connect; area recipients and chains check individually. No immunity or chip reduction is needed because current snow causes no residual damage. DEPENDENCY: recipient-targeted Status hit checks require a shared status interception path; self buffs and field setters remain automatic. Consume seeded accuracy RNG only during resolution and show probabilities without rolling in previews. The modifier ends immediately when snow ends or the ability is suppressed.

Name: Snow Warning
Description: The Pokémon makes it snow when it enters a battle.
Proposed: PROPOSED: On deployment, set the specified weather through the battle weather-state hook.
Exact Description: On entry, starts snow for 5 turns, or 8 turns if this Pokémon holds an Icy Rock. Snow multiplies Ice-type Pokémon's Defense by 1.5 (+50%) and causes no weather chip damage. Gen 8 and earlier: summons hail instead, which damages Pokémon that are not immune by 1/16 (6.25%) of their maximum HP per turn and provides no Defense boost.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Once on battle deployment, set ordinary snow for 50,000 AV, replacing prior ordinary weather. Snow retains the current 1.5 Defense bonus for Ice types and causes no weather chip damage. Repeated ability acquisition does not replay the initial deployment event; fainting does not end its timed weather. DEPENDENCY: Icy Rock metadata may extend duration to 80,000 AV when that item exists, and primal-weather ownership must block illegal replacements. Resolve simultaneous setters in stable roster order, with the final legal setter winning. Recalculate affected Speed immediately and share active weather and duration across inspection, previews, AI, and saved battle state.

Name: Solar Power
Description: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted, but its HP decreases every turn.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Run the described passive effect at each battle cycle tick while the holder is active.
Exact Description: If Sun is active, this Pokémon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5 (+50%) and it loses 1/8 (12.5%) of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. These effects are prevented if the Pokémon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While effective sun is active, multiply this holder's effective Special Attack by 1.5 for damaging Special moves. At each global 10,000-AV cycle boundary under that same condition, deal ceil(maximum HP / 8), minimum 1, to the living holder as indirect ability damage; this can faint it. ADAPTATION: use cycle ticks and ceiling fractions consistently with existing residual processing. No chip occurs on deployment or every personal turn, and no activation roll applies. Weather suppression disables both effects. DEPENDENCY: Utility Umbrella requires authored item opt-out metadata. Process the loss once per boundary and retain normal burn/weather/terrain damage independently.

Name: Solid Rock
Description: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks that hit the Pokémon.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon receives 3/4 (75%) damage from supereffective attacks.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When an incoming direct attack's resolved effectiveness against this holder's current types is greater than 1, multiply its damage by 0.75 before final minimum-one rounding. Apply independently to area and damage-only chain recipients; neutral, resisted, immune, and indirect damage remain unchanged. The ability is continuous with no chance, duration, cooldown, or stat stage. Unlike Prism Armor, this protection should be marked ignorable by an eligible Teravolt/Turboblaze attack in the reviewed bypass registry. Do not reduce effectiveness itself, since that could alter other super-effective triggers. Shared combat, damage previews, matchup cues, and enemy scoring must all apply the same rule.

Name: Soul-Heart
Description: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat every time another Pokémon faints.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described named stat modifier in battle stat calculation while its condition is active.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's Special Attack is raised by 1 stage when another Pokémon faints.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Whenever another deployed Pokémon on either team faints, every living Soul-Heart holder gains Special Attack +1, capped at +6, with that stat's expiry refreshed to 50,000 AV after the faint event. Count each distinct unit's transition from alive to fainted once, including weather or hazard defeats; never trigger on the holder's own faint. Simultaneous fainting is settled as one ordered batch, and only surviving recipients receive boosts. No distance check, random roll, or AP cost applies. DEPENDENCY: central faint-event dispatch is required because current hit and residual paths do not expose this reaction contract. Prevent duplicate callbacks during result checking and save the resulting stages.

Name: Soundproof
Description: Soundproofing gives the Pokémon full immunity to all sound-based moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Negate sound-tagged moves against this unit before damage or secondary effects resolve.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is immune to sound-based moves, unless it used the move.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Before damage or recipient effects resolve, this holder ignores moves carrying the existing sound tag when used by any other Pokémon, including teammates. Its own sound moves remain legal, so self-applied Howl still works while another unit's Howl cannot affect it. Block both damage and secondary effects without redirecting, healing, or changing the attacker's AP payment. No roll, timer, or cooldown applies; losing the ability immediately removes immunity. Add recipient-level Status interception because current cast-stage effects bypass damage checks. Apply the same contract to existing and future sound moves in previews, targeting, enemy scoring, and actual resolution; names alone never determine sound eligibility.

Name: Speed Boost
Description: The Pokémon's Speed stat is boosted every turn.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At each battle cycle tick, raise the holder Speed stage using normal stage expiry rules.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's Speed is raised by 1 stage at the end of each full turn it has been on the field.
Game Implementation: increase speed by +1 for each turn (not cycle)

Name: Spicy Spray
Description: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: When this Pokémon takes damage from an attack, it attempts to burn the attacker with no random activation roll (100% activation, subject to the attacker's burn immunity). Contact is not required.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: After an ordinary attack deals positive damage to this holder, attempt to burn its living attacker at 100% activation chance; contact is unnecessary and the hit snapshot permits reaction even if the holder faints. Apply existing burn for 20,000 AV, refresh on another eligible hit, and respect burn-prevention abilities through a shared status hook. The triggering attack resolves normally. Do not react to weather, burn, terrain, HP payments, or existing damage-only chain hits, and resolve at most once per incoming move. No activation RNG draw is needed. Retain normal burn Physical damage reduction and cycle damage; report immunity or applied burn in feedback.

Name: Stakeout
Description: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's offensive stat is doubled (2x) against a target that switched in this turn.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: Because targets cannot switch in, double this holder's effective offensive stat when attacking an opponent that completed an ordinary Move within the preceding 10,000 AV. Record each unit's latest committed voluntary Move timestamp; initial deployment, push/pull, and animation movement do not qualify. Check the target separately for each area/chain hit and snapshot eligibility at attack commitment. The bonus expires exactly one cycle after that Move and can be refreshed by a later legal Move. No chance, cooldown, or extra AP applies. This movement-punishing equivalent is deliberately strong and needs balance review; show the qualifying timer and damage in previews.

Name: Stall
Description: The Pokémon is always the last to use its moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Place this unit after other eligible units in the action scheduler regardless of its Speed.
Exact Description: This Pokémon moves last among Pokémon using the same or greater priority moves.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: At the end of every living holder turn, add 2,500 AV to its next scheduled action after calculating its normal Speed/Trick Room interval. This creates a visible slow-to-act drawback without introducing priority brackets or changing effective Speed. Apply once per ended turn, including Pass, and never once per individual Move, Attack, or Special command. Keep 3 AP gain, banking, and standard action limits; no chance or independent duration applies. Saved next-action shifts must survive reload and must not accumulate again during preview or queue refresh. Resolve simultaneous timestamps using existing stable queue order, and label this numerical AV substitution for review.

Name: Stalwart
Description: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Ignore opposing move-redirection effects when selecting and resolving this unit target.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Use the same shared redirection contract as Propeller Tail. A legal single-target move committed by this holder retains its selected target and ignores opponent/allied redirection abilities and future attraction effects, while range, line of sight, protection, accuracy, and target immunities remain mandatory. Area attacks keep their original footprint without acquiring extra targets, and reflected effects after impact are separate mechanics. No activation chance, AP change, timer, or cooldown applies. The current engine does not redirect moves, so enable this ability only alongside the redirection phase, source metadata, matching previews, and enemy targeting evaluation; no hidden target retargeting may occur.

Name: Stamina
Description: Boosts the Defense stat when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Whenever this unit takes a hit, raise its Defense stage through the post-hit stat hook.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's Defense is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a move.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: After this holder survives positive direct damage from an ordinary move, grant Defense +1, capped at +6, and refresh Defense's expiry to 50,000 AV after the hit. Trigger once per incoming move without a random roll, whether its category is Physical or Special. An area attack supplies one event for this recipient; existing damage-only chains, misses, type immunity, absorption, burn, weather, and hazards do not trigger post-hit reactions. The increase affects later damage rather than retroactively reducing the triggering hit. Add a generic incoming-damage hook shared with other reactive abilities, show the stage gain, and clear temporary stages at battle end.

Name: Stance Change
Description: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, modify the holder Attack through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is an Aegislash, it changes to Blade Forme before using an attacking move, and changes to Shield Forme before using King's Shield.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Register Aegislash Shield/Blade battle forms and King's Shield protection metadata. Immediately before an Aegislash holder commits a damaging Attack, change to Blade; immediately before successfully committing King's Shield, change to Shield. Other Status moves leave the form unchanged, and cancellations/invalid commands do not transform. Recalculate intrinsic level/rank stats once, retain current HP under an explicit preservation policy, AP, equipped moves, and the other ability slot, then reschedule Speed if necessary. No roll or cooldown applies; only the registered species can transform. Save temporary form state and restore ordinary party identity after battle. This adds neither ordinary switching nor Terastallization.

Name: Static
Description: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.
Proposed: CURRENT RULES: After contact damage, roll the paralysis reaction and apply its battle duration.
Exact Description: 30% chance a Pokémon making contact with this Pokémon will be paralyzed.
Game Implementation: After contact damage, 30% chance to paralyze the attacker for the rest of the game

Name: Steadfast
Description: The Pokémon's determination boosts its Speed stat every time it flinches.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After the described attack connects, run a chance-based flinch reaction in the post-hit hook.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add a typed flinch event that skips exactly the affected unit's next scheduled turn, consistent with the authored Stench proposal. When this living holder actually suffers a new flinch, grant Speed +1, capped at +6, and refresh Speed's five-cycle expiry. Trigger once per newly applied flinch, not on every queue update or repeated attempts while the same skip token is pending. If an immunity prevents flinch, no boost occurs. Immediately rescale remaining waiting AV while retaining fixed AP gain on future usable turns. No activation roll applies. Define flinch/skip persistence and consumption before making the ability selectable; previews must expose both consequences.

Name: Steam Engine
Description: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add an incoming-hit hook; check the described move or damage condition, then apply its prevention, healing, or stat response.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's Speed is raised by 6 stages after it is damaged by a Fire- or Water-type move.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: After this holder survives positive direct damage from an ordinary Fire- or Water-type move, apply Speed +6 stages, clamped to the normal +6 maximum, and refresh Speed's expiry to 50,000 AV after that hit. This means a unit currently at -2 rises to +4, rather than forcibly setting +6. Trigger once per incoming move with no activation roll; misses, immunities, absorption, indirect damage, and existing damage-only chains do not qualify. Repeated eligible hits may finish raising the stage or refresh it at the cap. Reschedule remaining AV immediately, keep AP gain unchanged, and show the resulting stage and queue change before future actions.

Name: Steelworker
Description: Powers up Steel-type moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 (+50%) while using a Steel-type attack.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Multiply this holder's effective offensive stat by 1.5 only while calculating resolved Steel-type attack damage, selecting Attack for Physical and Special Attack for Special moves. Apply after intrinsic rank and stage values without writing permanent stat changes; other types, Status moves, residual damage, AP, and movement are unchanged. No chance, timer, or cooldown applies. Combine independently with same-type bonus and a teammate's Steely Spirit aura, while identical duplicate ability entries apply only once. Converted moves use their final type for eligibility. Put the modifier in the shared offensive-stat path rather than a final-damage shortcut so previews, AI, and actual rounding agree.

Name: Steely Spirit
Description: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon and its allies' Steel-type moves have their power multiplied by 1.5 (+50%). This affects Doom Desire even if the user is not on the field.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While this living holder is active, multiply the power of resolved Steel-type damaging moves used by itself and every living teammate by 1.5 across the battlefield. Exclude enemies, Status moves, and residual damage. Several Steely Spirit sources provide one named aura multiplier per recipient, while different ability families such as Steelworker and Battery combine separately. Reevaluate immediately when a source faints, is suppressed, or loses the ability; no stored stage, chance, cooldown, or cycle duration exists. Existing direct and chain damage use the aura at resolution. DEPENDENCY: delayed Doom Desire-style attacks need an explicit source/aura snapshot policy before extending this behavior off-field.

Name: Stench
Description: By releasing a stench when attacking, the Pokémon may cause the target to flinch.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After the described attack connects, run a chance-based flinch reaction in the post-hit hook.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch.
Game Implementation: 10 chance to flinch an enemy for each hit (flinch makes a pokemon skip a turn)

Name: Sticky Hold
Description: The Pokémon's held items cling to its sticky body and cannot be removed by other Pokémon.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Check the described immunity or prevention rule before applying the affected status, move, stat, or field effect.
Exact Description: This Pokémon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokémon's Ability or attack, unless the attack knocks out this Pokémon. A Sticky Barb will be transferred to other Pokémon regardless of this Ability.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add typed held-item removal/transfer events with source identity. While this holder is alive, reject an opposing or allied Pokémon's attempted theft, knock-off, or forced item transfer; allow the holder's own genuine item consumption and lawful item activation. If an attack faints the holder, the item's post-faint removal rule may still resolve. Sticky Barb's special exception requires that item to exist and be explicitly marked. No chance, timer, or cooldown applies. Do not block the user's between-battle equipment changes or evolve-item use. The current held-item model has consumption but no theft; enable this protection only with reviewed removal mechanics, previews, and save validation.

Name: Storm Drain
Description: The Pokémon draws in all Water-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is immune to Water-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Water-type move. If this Pokémon is not the target of a single-target Water-type move used by another Pokémon, this Pokémon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokémon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Intercept a successful Water move against this holder, preventing damage and recipient effects and granting Special Attack +1 for five cycles, capped at +6; repeated moves refresh that stat timer. DEPENDENCY: redirect other Pokémon's single-unit Water moves only through a shared pre-hit redirection phase, requiring legal Manhattan range and line of sight from the original user. Choose highest effective Speed among eligible holders, then stable battle-unit order. Area moves are not redirected. Propeller Tail/Stalwart bypass redirection but not the holder's Water immunity. No activation roll or healing applies, and both active slots must resolve interception once rather than duplicate absorption.

Name: Strong Jaw
Description: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's bite-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.5 (+50%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add a reviewed bite trait to the move schema, move catalog, import validation, and inspection. Multiply this holder's damaging bite move power by 1.5, without changing type, range, AP cost, target shape, contact tag, delivery, or secondary effects. Do not treat all contact moves as bites or infer eligibility from animation; the current catalog has no authored bite-tagged move. No chance, timer, or cooldown applies. A converted bite retains its bite trait and uses its final type normally. Gate acquisition until compatible content exists, and make previews, enemy scoring, and engine damage use the same trait test.

Name: Sturdy
Description: The Pokémon cannot be knocked out by a single hit as long as its HP is full. One-hit KO moves will also fail to knock it out.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Before damage, preserve the holder at 1 HP from a lethal hit when the stated full-HP condition is met.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. OHKO moves fail when used against this Pokémon.
Game Implementation: Before damage, preserve the holder at 1 HP from a lethal hit when the stated full-HP condition is met.

Name: Suction Cups
Description: The Pokémon uses suction cups to stay in one spot. This protects it from moves and items that would force it to switch out.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a held-item trigger that checks the described condition and applies the stated item interaction.
Exact Description: This Pokémon cannot be forced to switch out by another Pokémon's attack or item.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: Prevent all forced tile displacement of this holder by another unit's push or pull effects, including existing Vine Whip and Water Pulse. The triggering move still deals normal damage and other eligible effects; the holder may use its ordinary voluntary Move normally. Do not prevent tile-entry hazards, terrain changes underneath it, or between-battle deployment placement. No range check, activation roll, cooldown, or duration applies while the ability is active. Add the check before each displacement sequence so no blocked step or hazard-entry animation occurs. A future forced-switch system may reuse this immunity, but this proposal introduces no switching or reserve command.

Name: Super Luck
Description: The Pokémon is so lucky that the critical-hit ratios of its moves are boosted.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described critical-hit adjustment when calculating the holder attack chance.
Exact Description: Raises this Pokémon's critical-hit stage by 1. In Gen 7 onward, the normal stage-0 rate of 1/24 (about 4.17%) becomes stage 1 at 1/8 (12.5%); stage 2 is 1/2 (50%) and stage 3 or above is 100%. Other critical-stage bonuses stack with this Ability.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Add one critical-rate stage to this holder's direct damaging hits. With the current default rate, this changes 1-in-24 to 1-in-8; a shared critical-stage table should use 1/24, 1/8, 1/2, then certainty at stage 3 or above. Other authored critical bonuses stack as stages rather than multiplying probabilities. Roll independently for every area recipient and existing damage-only chain, after successful accuracy/immunity checks. Defensive critical immunity still prevents criticals, and Sniper changes damage separately. No timer, cooldown, or extra AP applies. DEPENDENCY: introduce validated critical-stage metadata before adding other bonuses; previews display probability and damage bands without advancing RNG.

Name: Supersweet Syrup
Description: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle
