Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described accuracy or evasion change in attack hit-chance resolution under its stated condition.
Exact Description: On switch-in, this Pokémon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: Once per battle at deployment, mark all currently deployed living opponents with syrup for 50,000 AV. Against marked targets, all incoming ordinary move hit chances are multiplied by 1.25 and capped at 100%; this offsets Sand Veil/Snow Cloak's 0.8 factor to certainty. This replaces an unavailable evasion stage with a timed recipient modifier rather than altering the five supported stat stages. No activation roll, stacking, or retrigger on reacquisition applies; a second source refreshes only to the later expiry. Field/self effects remain automatic. Save marks and show their remaining duration, respecting suppression and the shared Status recipient hit-check dependency.

Name: Supreme Overlord
Description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, raise the holder Attack through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: When this Ability becomes active, this Pokémon's move power increases by 10% for each prior fainting on its side, up to 5 faintings: 1.1x, 1.2x, 1.3x, 1.4x, or 1.5x power (maximum +50%). The count is captured on entry and includes repeated faintings of a revived ally. It is a power modifier, not a stat-stage boost.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: While this holder remains deployed, count distinct living-to-fainted transitions of other teammates since battle start and multiply this holder's damaging move power by 1 + 0.1 times that count, capped at 1.5. Update after each central faint event because the current game has no later switch-in on which to snapshot prior faintings. Count each teammate once until a future revive system explicitly defines repeated faintings; enemies and the holder never count. This is a power modifier, not a stage, with no roll or expiry before battle end. Save the counter and expose its multiplier in inspection, previews, and enemy scoring; review dynamic scaling before adoption.

Name: Surge Surfer
Description: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: If Electric Terrain is active, this Pokémon's Speed is doubled (2x).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add the shared saved Electric Terrain battlefield field. While that effective terrain exists, double this holder's effective Speed even if its current mobility is airborne; terrain activation conditions for attacks and statuses are separately grounded. Reevaluate on terrain replacement, expiry, suppression, or ability loss and proportionally reschedule waiting AV. Combine normal Speed stages, paralysis, and Trick Room without changing 3 AP gain, Movement range, or one Move/Attack per turn. There is no random roll, independent timer, or stage. Electric Terrain itself should expire after its authored five cycles; show field duration and current Speed consistently before enabling this ability in Capsule choices.

Name: Swarm
Description: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: When this Pokémon has 1/3 (33 1/3%) or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 (+50%) while using a Bug-type attack.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While this holder has positive HP at or below floor(maximum HP / 3), multiply its effective offensive stat by 1.5 for resolved Bug-type damaging moves. Use Attack for Physical and Special Attack for Special moves, after stage and intrinsic rank calculations; other types and indirect damage are unchanged. Reevaluate before each attack, so healing above the threshold disables the bonus immediately without a latch. No chance, cooldown, or duration applies. The supplied one-third threshold is retained intentionally and must not be copied from current Torrent's strict below-half behavior. Show exact qualifying HP in inspection and share the rule across preview, AI, and actual damage.

Name: Sweet Veil
Description: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Check the described immunity or prevention rule before applying the affected status, move, stat, or field effect.
Exact Description: This Pokémon and its allies cannot fall asleep, but those already asleep do not wake up immediately. This Pokémon and its allies cannot use Rest successfully or become affected by Yawn, and those previously affected will not fall asleep.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add typed sleep, pending Yawn, and Rest move handling. While this living holder is active, it and all living teammates cannot receive new sleep or Yawn, and cannot successfully use Rest. Existing sleeping allies remain asleep until their normal cure/expiry; this ability does not itself cleanse them. Previously scheduled Yawn fails to cause sleep while protection is active. Use a battlefield-wide team aura with one protection regardless of duplicate sources; fainting or suppression removes it immediately. No chance, timer, AP bonus, or priority rule applies. Add recipient-level status checks and preview protected allies before enabling the ability; ordinary burn/paralysis remain unaffected.

Name: Swift Swim
Description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: If Rain is active, this Pokémon's Speed is doubled (2x). This effect is prevented if this Pokémon is holding a Utility Umbrella.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Double this holder's effective Speed while effective rain is active. Reevaluate on rain start, replacement, expiry, weather suppression, or ability loss and proportionally rescale a waiting unit's remaining AV rather than granting an immediate extra turn. Keep ordinary Speed stages, paralysis, and Trick Room composition, fixed 3 AP gain, banking, and one Move/Attack per turn. There is no random roll, timer, or stage independent of rain. DEPENDENCY: Utility Umbrella requires item-specific weather opt-out metadata before it can suppress this holder's effect. Use the same multiplier in inspection, queue preview, enemy scheduling, and actual turn activation, including fractional effective Speed.

Name: Sword of Ruin
Description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: Active Pokémon without this Ability have their Defense multiplied by 0.75 (-25%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While at least one living unsuppressed Sword of Ruin holder is deployed, multiply the effective Defense of every other living unit lacking Sword of Ruin by 0.75 across both teams. Holders are exempt, and identical sources do not stack. Apply as a continuous defensive-stat modifier for Physical damage after stages and intrinsic rank values; do not create a removable -1 stage or change Special Defense. Reevaluate immediately on fainting, suppression, copying, or ability loss. No roll or expiry applies. Preserve other Ruin families as separate modifiers, and include the reduced Defense in shared damage previews, inspection, and enemy scoring.

Name: Symbiosis
Description: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a held-item trigger that checks the described condition and applies the stated item interaction.
Exact Description: If an ally uses its item, this Pokémon gives its item to that ally immediately. Does not activate if the ally's item was stolen or knocked off, or if the ally used an Eject Button or Eject Pack.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add one shared item-consumed event and safe battle-only held-item transfer. When another living teammate genuinely consumes its held item and becomes empty-handed, this holder gives its own compatible equippable item to that teammate immediately, provided the holder has one. Exclude Bag items, species-incompatible Mega Stones, stolen/knocked-off items, and future Eject items. If several donors qualify, choose nearest Manhattan distance, then stable deployment order; only one donor transfers. The transfer is free, certain, and once per consumption event, and does not retrigger consumption or another donor chain. Persist both resulting held-item slots and reconcile the campaign at battle end through normal equipment validation.

Name: Synchronize
Description: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, modify the holder named stat through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: If another Pokémon burns, paralyzes, poisons, or badly poisons this Pokémon, that Pokémon receives the same non-volatile status condition.
Game Implementation: When this Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, the Pokemon will be inflicted with the same status condition.

Name: Tablets of Ruin
Description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: Active Pokémon without this Ability have their Attack multiplied by 0.75 (-25%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While a living unsuppressed Tablets of Ruin holder is deployed, multiply effective Attack by 0.75 for every living unit on either team that lacks this ability. All Tablets holders are exempt, identical sources do not stack, and Special Attack remains unchanged. Apply continuously after intrinsic rank/stage values, without writing negative stages, reducing move power, or modifying HP and AP. Reevaluate when a source faints or an ability changes; no chance, duration, or cooldown applies. Combine independently with other Ruin families and held-item Attack modifiers. Shared Physical damage calculation, inspection, previews, and enemy scoring must expose the same effective-stat reduction.

Name: Tangled Feet
Description: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Lower attacks hit chance against this unit while it is confused.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's evasiveness is doubled (2x) as long as it is confused.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add a saved timed confusion condition with explicit action/self-hit rules. While this holder is confused, multiply incoming ordinary move hit chance by 0.5, representing doubled evasion without introducing unsupported evasion stages. Apply per recipient before damage or targeted Status resolution; self buffs and battlefield effects remain automatic. This does not cure confusion, reduce its self-hit chance, prevent indirect damage, or alter movement legality. No activation roll, stacking, or independent expiry applies; ending confusion or losing the ability removes the modifier immediately. Combine multiplicatively with weather evasion, consume seeded hit RNG only on actual resolution, and show adjusted accuracy without rolling in previews.

Name: Tangling Hair
Description: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: Pokémon making contact with this Pokémon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: After an ordinary contact-tagged move deals positive damage to this holder, lower the living attacker's Speed by 1 stage, capped at -6, and refresh Speed's expiry to 50,000 AV. Use the hit snapshot so the reaction still occurs if the holder faints; current Static's survivor-only control flow must not silently prevent it. Trigger once per incoming move without an activation roll. Contact is separate from damage category and delivery; misses, immunity, absorption, indirect damage, and existing damage-only chains do not qualify. Resolve active-slot reactions in order without recursive contact events, reschedule the attacker's waiting/next interval, and display the final stage.

Name: Technician
Description: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.
Proposed: CURRENT RULES: Boost qualifying low-AP moves in shared damage calculation.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's moves of 60 power or less have their power multiplied by 1.5 (+50%), including Struggle. This effect comes after a move's effect changes its own power.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Preserve CURRENT CODE: damaging moves whose authored AP cost is at most 2 receive a 1.5 power multiplier, irrespective of their printed power. This intentionally differs from the supplied 60-power reference and fits the game's AP economy. Check the move's base listed AP cost, before Pressure surcharges or future discounts; paying more or less AP must not change eligibility. Status moves gain no damage, and type immunity still deals zero. No roll, timer, or cooldown applies. Existing given/hidden damage bonuses multiply with other eligible abilities, including Tough Claws. Keep one Attack per turn and ensure previews, AI, and actual rounding share this current rule.

Name: Telepathy
Description: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Attack modifier in battle stat calculation while its condition is active.
Exact Description: This Pokémon does not take damage from attacks made by its allies.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add typed damage-source side metadata and explicit friendly-fire move targeting. This holder receives zero direct damage from an allied Pokémon's attack, including allied areas and chains, while enemy attacks and allied non-damaging support effects resolve normally. Do not prevent burn, weather, lava, hazards, or its own recoil/self-inflicted costs merely because an ally originally created them. No roll, timer, cooldown, or extra range applies. CURRENT CODE already filters ordinary damaging moves to enemies, so this immunity has no present tactical effect; gate Capsule availability until friendly-fire-capable content exists. Preview protected recipients individually and retain the attacker's normal AP payment.

Name: Tera Shell
Description: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is a Terapagos at full HP, the effectiveness of attacks against it is changed to 0.5 unless this Pokémon is immune to the move. Multi-hit moves retain the same effectiveness throughout the attack.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Register Terapagos and species-gated defensive ability metadata. If a Terapagos holder is at exactly full HP when an attack begins resolving against it, replace nonzero type effectiveness with 0.5 for that entire incoming move; genuine immunity stays zero. Snapshot eligibility once per move so future multi-hit sequences retain the same effectiveness, while a later independent attack rechecks HP. Healing to full can reactivate protection with no cooldown or roll. This changes effectiveness, not merely final damage, so super-effective triggers must read the replacement. Exclude indirect damage, preserve other recipients, and update previews and matchup cues before enabling non-current species content.

Name: Tera Shift
Description: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.
Proposed: PROPOSED: On deployment, change this unit to its registered Terastal Form and update its battle types and stats.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon is a Terapagos, it transforms into its Terastal Form on entry.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add reviewed Terapagos Normal/Terastal species forms, visual assets, and a battle-only form registry beyond the present Mega special action. On initial deployment, a Terapagos in Normal Form deterministically changes to Terastal Form before ordinary action scheduling. Recalculate level/rank stats once, preserve HP fraction using ceiling capped at the new maximum, retain AP, equipped moves, and the unlocked second slot, and adopt the form's explicitly authored given ability. Non-Terapagos recipients do nothing. Persist the battle form and avoid replaying on reload or suppression. Restore ordinary party identity after battle; this automatic form change neither introduces a Terastallize command nor grants Stellar Form.

Name: Teraform Zero
Description: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: Terapagos: Terastallizing ends the effects of weather and terrain. Once per battle.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add Terapagos's reviewed Stellar transformation and an explicitly authorized Terastallization action before enabling this ability; Mega Evolution must not silently count. Once per battle, when that eligible transformation commits, end ordinary weather and the active terrain field immediately, remove their modifiers, and reschedule affected waiting units. Specify interaction with source-owned primordial weather in the shared weather registry: proposed choice is suspend primal effects until a genuinely new source activation rather than instantly restoring them. Consume the once-per-battle latch even if both fields were already clear, with no roll or AP refund. Save transformation/latch state and show removed fields in confirmation previews.

Name: Teravolt
Description: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Skip the target ability checks for this unit move resolution.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokémon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokémon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokémon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokémon.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add attack-scoped ability-bypass metadata using the supplied reviewed allowlist. During this holder's committed move and resulting effects, ignore only marked suppressible defenses of affected units, including relevant immunity, accuracy, stage-prevention, reflection, and aura checks; do not globally erase either active ability slot. Source damage bonuses, immutable/form abilities, Prism Armor/Shadow Shield, unrelated residual ticks, and future actions remain active. Restore all checks when the move finishes, even after a miss or exception. No chance, timer, or cooldown applies. Armor Tail range legality and Dazzling immunity require the same scope in previews and AI; share this complete contract with Turboblaze.

Name: Thermal Exchange
Description: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add an incoming-hit hook; check the described move or damage condition, then apply its prevention, healing, or stat response.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's Attack is raised 1 stage after it is damaged by a Fire-type move. This Pokémon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Prevent burn from being applied to this holder and cure an active burn immediately when it gains the ability. After the holder survives positive ordinary Fire-type move damage, grant Attack +1, capped at +6, and refresh Attack's five-cycle expiry. Fire damage itself is not prevented or reduced; Water, indirect burn/weather damage, misses, absorption, and existing damage-only chains do not trigger the stage reaction. Trigger once per incoming move with no activation roll. Use a shared status-application gate so Ember and future contact/status sources obey protection. Reevaluate the Physical burn penalty immediately after curing, show both effects in feedback, and preserve the other active ability slot.

Name: Thick Fat
Description: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: If a Pokémon uses a Fire- or Ice-type attack against this Pokémon, that Pokémon's offensive stat is halved (0.5x) when calculating the damage to this Pokémon.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When calculating Fire- or Ice-type direct attack damage against this holder, halve the attacker's effective offensive stat for this target only, using Attack or Special Attack according to move category. Keep the source's stored stats and damage to other area recipients unchanged, and retain normal effectiveness, same-type bonus, weather, criticals, and minimum-one rounding. This is not a global Attack debuff or temporary stat stage. No activation roll, timer, or cooldown applies. It does not prevent burn, snow effects, weather chip, lava, or hazards. Put the modifier in the shared offensive-stat calculation, with identical previews and enemy scoring rather than approximating by halving final damage.

Name: Tinted Lens
Description: The Pokémon can use “not very effective” moves to deal regular damage.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's attacks that are not very effective on a target deal double damage.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: If this holder's resolved damaging move is resisted by a target, with total effectiveness greater than zero but below 1, multiply that target's final move damage by 2. Do not alter the actual effectiveness value, bypass immunity, or boost neutral/super-effective hits; a quarter-effective attack becomes effectively half-strength damage rather than neutral. Evaluate independently for every direct or chain recipient after temporary types and effectiveness replacement abilities. No roll, timer, cooldown, or stored stage applies. Exclude burn, weather, lava, and hazards. Shared previews, board cues, and AI should retain the resisted matchup label while displaying the doubled resisted damage consistently with combat rounding.

Name: Torrent
Description: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
Proposed: CURRENT RULES: Apply the low-HP Water damage bonus in shared damage calculation.
Exact Description: When this Pokémon has 1/3 (33 1/3%) or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 (+50%) while using a Water-type attack.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Preserve CURRENT CODE: this holder's Water-type damaging move power is multiplied by 1.5 only while current HP is strictly below 50% of maximum HP; exactly half does not qualify. This differs from the supplied one-third reference, so changing to that reference would be a separate balance decision, not a missing implementation fix. Reevaluate per hit after healing or damage without a stored latch, roll, duration, or cooldown. Preserve existing multiplicative interaction with other active damage abilities and all AP costs/action limits. Status moves and indirect damage receive no bonus. Confirm odd-maximum-HP thresholds, previews, enemy scoring, and current ability feedback using the same strict comparison.

Name: Tough Claws
Description: Powers up moves that make direct contact.
Proposed: CURRENT RULES: Boost damage from moves tagged as contact.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3 (+30%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Preserve CURRENT CODE: multiply this holder's damaging contact-tagged move power by 1.3, using the existing contact trait rather than Physical category or melee delivery. Eligible moves such as Vine Whip retain their ordinary range, AP cost, displacement, and reaction exposure; non-contact Physical moves receive no bonus. Apply once per active Tough Claws definition and combine multiplicatively with Technician or another different eligible damage ability. No activation roll, timer, or cooldown is added. Type immunity remains zero and Status moves gain no damage. Keep the shared ability multiplier in previews, enemy scoring, direct damage, and existing damage-only chain calculations; optional additional contact moves require reviewed tags.

Name: Toxic Boost
Description: Powers up physical moves when the Pokémon is poisoned.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: While this Pokémon is poisoned, the power of its physical attacks is multiplied by 1.5 (+50%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Introduce a typed poison condition, including ordinary versus escalating poison, duration/cure rules, immunity checks, and saved residual counters. While either poison form is active on this holder, multiply its Physical damaging move power by 1.5; other move categories, poison chip, AP, and movement remain unchanged. Poison damage still occurs normally at global cycle boundaries, and curing poison removes the bonus immediately. No extra activation chance, timer, or cooldown applies. Do not infer poison from arbitrary status keys or reuse burn/paralysis timers. A proposed poison baseline lasts until cure or battle end, with explicit cycle ticks; previews and actual damage share the condition once that system exists.

Name: Toxic Chain
Description: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's attacks have a 30% chance of badly poisoning. This effect comes before a move's inherent secondary effect chance.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add typed escalating poison with immunity, cure, and saved cycle-counter support. After each successful positive ordinary direct hit by this holder, roll a seeded 30% chance per surviving enemy recipient to inflict escalating poison before the move's own secondary effects. Proposed poison damage is ceil(n times maximum HP / 16), minimum 1, at each global cycle boundary, with n starting at 1 and increasing per tick until cure or battle end. Do not overwrite an existing major poison or reset its escalation on repeated applications. Existing damage-only chain hits do not receive secondary ability reactions. Previews show chance only, and immunity consumes no application.

Name: Toxic Debris
Description: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: When this Pokémon is hit by a physical damaging move, places 1 layer of Toxic Spikes on the opposing side, up to 2 layers total. One layer poisons grounded opponents on entry; 2 layers badly poison them. Qualifying multi-hit attacks can add a layer with each hit. Normal hazard immunities and removal by grounded Poison types still apply.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: DEPENDENCY: Add typed poison-hazard zones. After ordinary Physical damage, use the holder's hit snapshot, even if fainted, to place a two-cycle 3×3 zone centered on the attacker and capped to the board. One zone per holder starts at one layer; each later qualifying hit relocates/refreshes it and increments layers to min(2, layers + 1). Combat-grounded units of either team entering receive ordinary poison at one layer or escalating poison at two; ordinary poison cannot downgrade existing escalating poison. Grounded Poison units remove the zone; Steel rejects poison unless Corrosion applies. Exclude residual/damage-only chain activation. No roll applies; preview/save layers and expiry.

Name: Trace
Description: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon copies an opposing Pokémon's Ability.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Run the described effect once on deployment, targeting the stated units or battle field.
Exact Description: On switch-in, this Pokémon copies a random opposing Pokémon's Ability. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Teraform Zero, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Trace, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero. If no opposing Pokémon has an Ability that can be copied, this Ability will activate as soon as one does.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add battle-only slot overrides and the supplied copyability table. On deployment, collect opposing living units' eligible active abilities in stable deployment/slot order, excluding the holder's other slot ID; choose one candidate with one seeded uniform roll. Replace only the Trace-bearing slot until battle end, preserving ordinary party assignments. If no candidate exists, retry only on a relevant opponent ability-change event, without repeated frame polling. Reconcile lost auras and run acquisition-specific hooks once; do not replay deployment-only bonuses. Persist the selected override so reloads cannot reroll. Previews show eligible possibilities without consuming RNG or revealing an uncommitted result.

Name: Transistor
Description: Powers up Electric-type moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.3 (+30%) while using an Electric-type attack. Gen 8: the Electric offensive-stat multiplier was 1.5 (+50%) instead of 1.3 (+30%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: Multiply this holder's effective offensive stat by 1.3 when calculating a resolved Electric-type damaging move, using Attack for Physical or Special Attack for Special moves. Apply after staged intrinsic stats rather than as a stored stage or final-damage shortcut; other types, Status effects, residual damage, AP gain, and Movement remain unchanged. This intentionally uses the supplied modern 1.3 value rather than the older 1.5 variant. No chance, timer, or cooldown applies. Combine separately with same-type bonus, weather, and other eligible ability families, respecting immunity/absorption. Shared combat, damage previews, and AI must use the same offensive-stat placement and fixed-point rounding.

Name: Triage
Description: Gives priority to the Pokémon's healing moves.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: DEPENDENCY: Add an authored healing-move trait and HP-recovery effect; do not classify Berry use, Leftovers, draining damage, or route healing as healing moves automatically. After this holder commits a qualifying healing Status Attack, advance its next scheduled action by 5,000 AV, capped at current time, once per turn. Heal the selected legal recipient by the move's own amount, even if full HP makes actual recovery zero, while paying the listed AP and using the normal single Attack allowance. This substitutes a concrete AV reward for unavailable +3 priority. Save the action shift and preview it; no extra RNG, turn, or free Move is granted.

Name: Truant
Description: Each time the Pokémon uses a move, it spends the next turn loafing around.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After this unit acts, skip its next scheduled action, then alternate between acting and loafing.
Exact Description: This Pokémon skips every other turn instead of using a move.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: ADAPTATION: A committed Attack, including a Status move, arms one loafing turn for this holder. At its next scheduled activation, grant the usual 3 AP to its bank, display loafing, allow no Move, Attack, or Special, and immediately end that turn with a normal Speed-based next interval. Clear the token afterward so the following activation is usable. A normal turn spent only moving, using Special, or passing does not arm another loaf, and invalid/cancelled attacks do not count. No random roll or AV-cycle duration applies. Save the pending token, keep global residual/stage events running, and prevent repeated end-turn calls from granting duplicate AP.

Name: Turboblaze
Description: The Pokémon's moves are unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Skip the target ability checks for this unit move resolution.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokémon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokémon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokémon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokémon.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Implement the same move-scoped defensive-ability bypass as Teravolt, using the supplied explicit negation allowlist rather than disabling all target abilities. While this holder's move resolves, skip eligible immunity, accuracy, prevention, reflection, defensive-stat, and relevant aura effects, including matching hidden-slot checks; keep immutable/form abilities and unignorable Prism Armor/Shadow Shield intact. Scope begins during target/range legality and ends after the move's effects, with no lasting suppression of other actions or residual ticks. No activation roll, timer, or cooldown applies. Share one context object across previews, AI, targeting, pure damage, and status effects so bypass cannot leak or disagree between systems.

Name: Unaware
Description: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.
Proposed: PROPOSED: At the described trigger, modify the holder Attack through battle stat stages or an effective-stat modifier.
Exact Description: This Pokémon ignores other Pokémon's Attack, Special Attack, and accuracy stat stages when taking damage, and ignores other Pokémon's Defense, Special Defense, and evasiveness stat stages when dealing damage.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: For this holder's damaging attacks, treat the target's relevant Defense/Special Defense stage as zero; when this holder takes damage, treat the attacker's relevant Attack/Special Attack stage as zero. Preserve both units' stored stages, intrinsic level/rank multipliers, held-item modifiers, weather, and continuous abilities. The holder's own stages still apply in its own offensive/defensive role. No roll, timer, or cooldown applies. DEPENDENCY: if accuracy/evasion stages are later added, extend the same role-based ignore rule there; do not erase present weather evasion or range effects. Compute critical stage bypass and Unaware together deterministically in shared damage, preview, and AI paths.

Name: Unburden
Description: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described Speed or action-order rule in the battle scheduler, checking its stated condition.
Exact Description: If this Pokémon loses its held item for any reason, its Speed is doubled (2x) as long as it remains active, has this Ability, and is not holding an item.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: When this holder genuinely consumes or loses any held item during battle, double effective Speed while it remains empty-handed and the ability is active. An item received midbattle qualifies on later loss; starting with None alone does not. Current Sitrus Berry and consumed X Attack can trigger it; theft/removal requires future item-loss events. Receiving another item suspends the bonus, and losing it reactivates one doubling rather than stacking. Persist the triggered flag, recalculate on lawful item/ability changes, and proportionally reschedule waiting AV. No roll, stage, or independent timer applies; battle end clears the flag and AP gain remains 3 per scheduled turn.

Name: Unnerve
Description: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.
Proposed: PROPOSED: While deployed, block opposing Berry activations in the item-trigger hook.
Exact Description: While this Pokémon is active, it prevents opposing Pokémon from using their Berries. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While this living holder is deployed, prevent all living opponents from automatically consuming Berry-tagged held items; their Sitrus Berry remains equipped and its recovery does not occur. Do not block the holder, teammates, Leftovers, X Attack, Mega Stones, Bag use, or route healing. Reevaluate immediately when the final opposing Unnerve source faints or is suppressed; if an eligible surviving Pokémon is already at its Berry threshold, attempt consumption once after that state change. Duplicate sources add no stronger restriction. No chance, timer, or cooldown applies. DEPENDENCY: explicit Berry metadata and an ordered item-trigger event are needed so custom As One can reuse the same effect.

Name: Unseen Fist
Description: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: This Pokémon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add typed recipient protection with source, duration, scope, and Max Guard classification. This holder's contact-tagged moves bypass ordinary Protect-style barriers for damage and normal secondary effects; non-contact moves still obey them, and Max Guard remains effective. Contact is separate from Physical category or melee delivery, and bypass must not remove the barrier for later attackers. Preserve normal AP cost, range, accuracy, type immunity, absorption, and contact reactions, with no roll or cooldown. The present game has no Protect mechanic, so gate ability availability until compatible protection content exists. Shared target previews and enemy scoring must distinguish bypassed protection from genuinely immune targets.

Name: Vessel of Ruin
Description: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Add a conditional modifier to shared damage calculation for the move, type, target, and conditions described.
Exact Description: Active Pokémon without this Ability have their Special Attack multiplied by 0.75 (-25%).
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While a living unsuppressed Vessel of Ruin holder is deployed, multiply effective Special Attack by 0.75 for every living battlefield unit on either side that lacks Vessel of Ruin. Holders are exempt; multiple sources provide one reduction, while different Ruin families remain independent. Apply after intrinsic rank and current stages without creating a removable stage or reducing Physical Attack, AP, movement, or residual damage. Reevaluate immediately when a source faints, is suppressed, or changes ability. No activation chance, duration, or cooldown applies. Shared Special damage, inspection, previews, and enemy scoring must agree, including interactions with Battery and other offensive-stat modifiers.

Name: Victory Star
Description: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Apply the described accuracy or evasion change in attack hit-chance resolution under its stated condition.
Exact Description: This Pokémon and its allies' moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.1.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: While this living holder is active, multiply hit chance for moves used by itself and every living teammate by 1.1, capped at 100%, after base accuracy and recipient evasion factors. Current ordinary certain hits remain certain; attacks against Sand Veil at 80% become 88% before other modifiers. Multiple Victory Star sources supply one multiplier, while different named accuracy effects combine separately. No roll, timer, cooldown, range increase, or stage applies to the aura itself. Self buffs and field setters remain automatic. DEPENDENCY: recipient-targeted Status accuracy needs the shared hit-check path. Previews display percentages without consuming RNG; actual hit attempts use seeded battle RNG.

Name: Vital Spirit
Description: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Check the described immunity or prevention rule before applying the affected status, move, stat, or field effect.
Exact Description: This Pokémon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add a typed sleep status and pending-Yawn state with saved duration/action restrictions. This holder cannot receive sleep, and gaining Vital Spirit immediately cures existing sleep and removes its queued sleep-caused skipped turns. Cancel pending Yawn rather than allowing it to apply sleep later, and reject Rest's sleep-dependent healing if the move is added. No random roll, timer, cooldown, or aura scope applies; protection covers only this holder while the ability is active. Burn, paralysis, poison, stat stages, and confusion remain unaffected. Use one shared sleep-prevention family with Insomnia, show immunity in move previews, and gate availability until sleep content exists.

Name: Volt Absorb
Description: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
Proposed: PROPOSED: Intercept Electric hits before damage and restore HP using the ability description healing rule.
Exact Description: This Pokémon is immune to Electric-type moves and restores 1/4 (25%) of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by an Electric-type move.
Game Implementation: after getting hit with an electric move heal 25% of max hp

Name: Wandering Spirit
Description: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
Proposed: PROPOSED: After contact damage, run a post-hit reaction using the described chance, status, or ability-transfer effect.
Exact Description: Pokémon making contact with this Pokémon have their Ability swapped with this one. Does not affect Pokémon with the Abilities As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
proposed game implementation(detailed): PROPOSED: DEPENDENCY: Add temporary battle ability swapping and the supplied exclusion table. After ordinary contact damage, use the hit snapshot to swap this holder's Wandering Spirit slot with the living attacker's first eligible active slot, given before hidden, even if the holder faints. Reject duplicate IDs and resolve once per attack without recursion or randomness. Reconcile speed, auras, and immunity, running acquisition-specific hooks only; never replay deployment-only bonuses. Retain other slots, species, items, and AP; fainted units contribute no aura. Exclude indirect damage and existing damage-only chains. Persist both temporary profiles and restore owned assignments after battle, with explicit swap feedback.

Name: Water Absorb
